content: 18.61 The Lord dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, causing all beings, by His illusive power, to revolve as if mounted on a machine.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.62 Fly unto Him for refuge with all thy being, O Arjuna; by His grace thou shalt obtain supreme peace (and) the eternal abode.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.63 Thus has wisdom, more secret than secrecy itself, been declared unto thee by Me; having reflected over it fully, then act as thou wishest.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.64 Hear thou again My supreme word, most secret of all; because thou art dearly beloved of Me, I will tell thee what is good.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.65 Fix thy mind on Me, by devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me. Thou shalt come even to Me; truly do I promise unto thee, (for) thou art dear to Me.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.66 Abandoning all duties, take refuge in Me alone: I will liberate thee from all sins; grieve not.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.67 This is never to be spoken by thee to one who is devoid of austerities or devotion, nor to one who does not render service or who does not desire to listen, nor to one who cavils at Me.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.68 He who with supreme devotion to Me will teach this supreme secret to My devotees, shall doubtlessly come to Me.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.69 Nor is there any among men who does dearer service to Me, nor shall there be another on earth dearer to Me than he.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.70 And he who will study this sacred dialogue of ours, by him I shall have been worshipped by the sacrifice of wisdom, such is My conviction.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.71 Also the man who hears this, full of faith and free from malice, he, too, liberated, shall attain to the happy worlds of those of righteous deeds.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.72 Has this been heard, O Arjuna, with one-pointed mind? Has the delusion of thy ignorance been destroyed, O Dhananjaya?

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.73 Arjuna said Destroyed is my delusion as I have gained my knowledge (memory) through Thy grace, O Krishna. I remain freed from doubts. I will act according to Thy word.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.74 Sanjaya said Thus I have heard this wonderful dialogue between Krishna and the high-souled Arjuna, which causes the hair to stand on end.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.75 Through the grace of Vyasa I have heard this supreme and most secret Yoga direct from Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, Himself declaring it.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.76 O King, remembering this wonderful and holy dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.77 And, remembering again and again, also that most wonderful form of Hari, great is my wonder, O King; and I rejoice again and again.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.78 Wherever is Krishna, the Lord of Yoga; wherever is Arjuna, the wielder of the bow; there are prosperity, victory, happiness and firm policy; such is my conviction.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.1 धर्मक्षेत्रे on the holy plain? कुरुक्षेत्रे in Kurukshetra? समवेताः assembled together? युयुत्सवः desirous to fight? मामकाः my people? पाण्डवाः the sons of Pandu? च and? एव also? किम् what? अकुर्वत did do? सञ्जय O Sanjaya.Commentary Dharmakshetra -- that place which protects Dharma is Dharmakshetra. Because it was in the land of the Kurus? it was called Kurukshetra.Sanjaya is one who has conered likes and dislikes and who is impartial.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.2 दृष्ट्वा having seen? तु indeed? पाण्डवानीकम् the army of the Pandavas? व्यूढम् drawn up in battlearray? दुर्योधनः Duryodhana? तदा then? आचार्यम् the teacher? उपसङ्गम्य having approached? राजा the king? वचनम् speech? अब्रवीत् said.No Commentary.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.3 पश्य behold? एताम् this? पाण्डुपुत्राणाम् of the sons of Pandu? आचार्य O Teacher? महतीम् great? चमूम् army? व्यूढाम् arrayed? द्रुपदपुत्रेण son of Drupada? तव शिष्येण by your disciple? धीमता wise.No Commentary.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.4 अत्र here? शूराः heroes? महेष्वासाः mighty archers? भीमार्जुनसमाः eal to Bhima and Arjuna? युधि in battle? युयुधानः Yuyudhana? विराटः Virata? च and? द्रुपदः Drupada? च and? महारथः of the great car.Commentary Technically? maharatha means a warrior who is proficient in the science of war and who is able to fight alone with ten thousand archers.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.5 धृष्टकेतुः Dhrishtaketu? चेकितानः Chekitana? काशिराजः king of Kasi? च and? वीर्यवान् valiant? पुरुजित् Purujit? कुन्तिभोजः Kuntibhoja? च and? शैब्यः son of Sibi? च and? नरपुङ्गवः the best of men.No Commentary.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.6 युधामन्युः Yudhamanyu? च and? विक्रान्तः the strong? उत्तमौजाः Uttamaujas? च and? वीर्यवान् the brave? सौभद्रः the son of Subhadra? द्रौपदेयाः the sons of Draupadi? च and? सर्वे all? एव even? महारथाः great carwarriors.No Commentary.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.7 अस्माकम् ours? तु also? विशिष्टाः the best? ये who (those)? तान् those? निबोध know (thou)? द्विजोत्तम (O) best among the twicorn ones? नायकाः the leaders? मम my? सैन्यस्य of the army? संज्ञार्थम् for information? तान् them? ब्रवीमि speak? ते to thee.No Commentary.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.8 भवान् yourself? भीष्मः Bhishma? च and? कर्णः Karna? च and? कृपः Kripa? च and? समितिञ्जयः victorious in war? अश्वत्थामा Asvatthama? the son of Dronacharya? विकर्णः Vikarna? च and? सौमदत्तिः the son of Somadatta? तथा thus? एव even? च and.No Commentary.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.9 अन्ये others? च and? बहवः many? शूराः heroes? मदर्थे for my sake? त्यक्तजीविताः who are ready to give up their lives? नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः armed with various weapons and missiles? सर्वे all? युद्धविशारदाः wellskilled in battle.No Commentary.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending

Sridhara Swami takes the word aparyaptam to mean insufficient. Ananda Giri takes it to mean unlimited.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.11 अयनेषु in the arrays (of the army)? च and? सर्वेषु in all? यथाभागम् according to division? अवस्थिताः being stationed? भीष्मम् Bhishma? एव alone? अभिरक्षन्तु protect? भवन्तः ye? सर्वे all? एव even? हि indeed.No Commentary.

author: Swami Sivananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.12 तस्य his (Duryodhanas)? संजयन् causing? हर्षम् joy? कुरुवृद्धः oldest of the Kurus? पितामहः grandfather? सिंहनादम् lions roar? विनद्य having sounded? उच्चैः loudly? शङ्खम् conch? दध्मौ blew? प्रतापवान् the glorious.No Commentary.
