content: 5.24 He who is happy within his Self and has found Its peace, and in whom the inner light shines, that sage attains Eternal Bliss and becomes the Spirit Itself.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 5.25 Sages whose sins have been washed away, whose sense of separateness has vanished, who have subdued themselves, and seek only the welfare of all, come to the Eternal Spirit.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 5.26 Saints who know their Selves, who control their minds, and feel neither desire nor anger, find Eternal Bliss everywhere.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 5.27 Excluding external objects, his gaze fixed between the eyebrows, the inward and outward breathings passing equally through his nostrils;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 5.28 Governing sense, mind and intellect, intent on liberation, free from desire, fear and anger, the sage is forever free.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 5.29 Knowing me as Him who gladly receives all offerings of austerity and sacrifice, as the Might Ruler of all the Worlds and the Friend of all beings, he passes to Eternal Peace."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.1 "Lord Shri Krishna said: He who acts because it is his duty, not thinking of the consequences, is really spiritual and a true ascetic; and not he who merely observes rituals or who shuns all action.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.2 O Arjuna! Renunciation is in fact what is called Right Action. No one can become spiritual who has not renounced all desire.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.3 For the sage who seeks the heights of spiritual meditation, practice is the only method, and when he has attained them, he must maintain himself there by continual self-control.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.4 When a man renounces even the thought of initiating action, when he is not interested in sense objects or any results which may flow from his acts, then in truth he understands spirituality.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.5 Let him seek liberation by the help of his Highest Self, and let him never disgrace his own Self. For that Self is his only friend; yet it may also be his enemy.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.6 To him who has conquered his lower nature by Its help, the Self is a friend, but to him who has not done so, It is an enemy.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.7 The Self of him who is self-controlled, and has attained peace is equally unmoved by heat or cold, pleasure or pain, honour or dishonour.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.8 He who desires nothing but wisdom and spiritual insight, who has conquered his senses and who looks with the same eye upon a lump of earth, a stone or fine gold, is a real saint.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.9 He looks impartially on all - lover, friend or foe; indifferent or hostile; alien or relative; virtuous or sinful.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.10 Let the student of spirituality try unceasingly to concentrate his mind; Let him live in seclusion, absolutely alone, with mind and personality controlled, free from desire and without possessions.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.11 Having chosen a holy place, let him sit in a firm posture on a seat, neither too high nor too low, and covered with a grass mat, a deer skin and a cloth.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.12 Seated thus, his mind concentrated, its functions controlled and his senses governed, let him practise meditation for the purification of his lower nature.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.13 Let him hold body, head and neck erect, motionless and steady; let him look fixedly at the tip of his nose, turning neither to the right nor to the left.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.14 With peace in his heart and nor fear, observing the vow of celibacy, with mind controlled and fixed on Me, let the student lose himself in contemplation of Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.15 Thus keeping his mind always in communion with Me, and with his thoughts subdued, he shall attain that Peace which is mine and which will lead him to liberation at last.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.16 Meditation is not for him who eats too much, not for him who eats not at all; not for him who is overmuch addicted to sleep, not for him who is always awake.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.17 But for him who regulates his food and recreation, who is balanced in action, in sleep and in waking, it shall dispel all unhappiness.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.18 When the mind, completely controlled, is centered in the Self, and free from all earthly desires, then is the man truly spiritual.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.19 The wise man who has conquered his mind and is absorbed in the Self is as a lamp which does not flicker, since it stands sheltered from every wind.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.20 There, where the whole nature is seen in the light of the Self, where the man abides within his Self and is satisfied there, its functions restrained by its union with the Divine, the mind finds rest.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.21 When he enjoys the Bliss which passes sense, and which only the Pure Intellect can grasp, when he comes to rest within his own highest Self, never again will he stray from reality.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.22 Finding That, he will realise that there is no possession so precious. And when once established here, no calamity can disturb him.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.23 This inner severance from the affliction of misery is spirituality. It should be practised with determination and with a heart which refuses to be depressed.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.24 Renouncing every desire which imagination can conceive, controlling the senses at every point by the power of mind;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.25 Little by little, by the help of his reason controlled by fortitude, let him attain peace; and, fixing his mind on the Self, let him not think of any other thing.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.26 When the volatile and wavering mind would wander, let him restrain it and bring it again to its allegiance to the Self.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.27 Supreme Bliss is the lot of the sage, whose mind attains Peace, whose passions subside, who is without sin, and who becomes one with the Absolute.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.28 Thus, free from sin, abiding always in the Eternal, the saint enjoys without effort the Bliss which flows from realisation of the Infinite.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.29 He who experiences the unity of life sees his own Self in all beings, and all beings in his own Self, and looks on everything with an impartial eye;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.30 He who sees Me in everything and everything in Me, him shall I never forsake, nor shall he lose Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.31 The sage who realises the unity of life and who worships Me in all beings, lives in Me, whatever may be his lot.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.32 O Arjuna! He is the perfect saint who, taught by the likeness within himself, sees the same Self everywhere, whether the outer form be pleasurable or painful.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.33 Arjuna said: I do not see how I can attain this state of equanimity which Thou has revealed, owing to the restlessness of my mind.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.34 My Lord! Verily, the mind is fickle and turbulent, obstinate and strong, yea extremely difficult as the wind to control.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.35 Lord Shri Krishna replied: Doubtless, O Mighty One, the mind is fickle and exceedingly difficult to restrain, but, O Son of Kunti, with practice and renunciation it can be done.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.36 It is not possible to attain Self-Realisation if a man does not know how to control himself; but for him who, striving by proper means, learns such control, it is possible.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.37 Arjuna asked: He who fails to control himself, whose mind falls from spiritual contemplation, who attains not perfection but retains his faith, what of him, my Lord?

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Shri Purohit Swami did not comment on this sloka

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.39 My Lord! Thou art worthy to solve this doubt once and for all; save Thyself there is no one competent to do so.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.40 Lord Shri Krishna replied: My beloved child! There is no destruction for him, either in this world or in the next. No evil fate awaits him who treads the path of righteousness.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.41 Having reached the worlds where the righteous dwell, and having remained there for many years, he who has slipped from the path of spirituality will be born again in the family of the pure, benevolent and prosperous.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.42 Or, he may be born in the family of the wise sages, though a birth like this is, indeed, very difficult to obtain.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.43 Then the experience acquired in his former life will revive, and with its help he will strive for perfection more eagerly than before.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.44 Unconsciously he will return to the practices of his old life; so that he who tries to realise spiritual consciousness is certainly superior to one who only talks of it.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.45 Then after many lives, the student of spirituality, who earnestly strives, and whose sins are absolved, attains perfection and reaches the Supreme.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.46 The wise man is superior to the ascetic and to the scholar and to the man of action; therefore be thou a wise man, O Arjuna!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 6.47 I look upon him as the best of mystics who, full of faith, worshippeth Me and abideth in Me."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.1 "Lord Shri Krishna said: Listen, O Arjuna! And I will tell thee how thou shalt know Me in my Full perfection, practising meditation with thy mind devoted to Me, and having Me for thy refuge.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.2 I will reveal to this knowledge unto thee, and how it may be realised; which, once accomplished, there remains nothing else worth having in this life.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.3 Among thousands of men scarcely one strives for perfection, and even amongst those who gain occult powers, perchance but one knows me in truth.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.4 Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect and personality; this is the eightfold division of My Manifested Nature.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.5 This is My inferior Nature; but distinct from this, O Valiant One, know thou that my Superior Nature is the very Life which sustains the universe.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.6 It is the womb of all being; for I am He by Whom the worlds were created and shall be dissolved.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.7 O Arjuna! There is nothing higher than Me; all is strung upon Me as rows of pearls upon a thread.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.8 O Arjuna! I am the Fluidity in water, the Light in the sun and in the moon. I am the mystic syllable Om in the Vedic scriptures, the Sound in ether, the Virility in man.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.9 I am the Fragrance of earth, the Brilliance of fire. I am the Life Force in all beings, and I am the Austerity of the ascetics.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.10 Know, O Arjuna, that I am the eternal Seed of being; I am the Intelligence of the intelligent, the Splendour of the resplendent.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.11 I am the Strength of the strong, of them who are free from attachment and desire; and, O Arjuna, I am the Desire for righteousness.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.12 Whatever be the nature of their life, whether it be pure or passionate or ignorant, they are all derived from Me. They are in Me, but I am not in them.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.13 The inhabitants of the world, misled by those natures which the Qualities have engendered, know not that I am higher than them all, and that I do not change.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.14 Verily, this Divine Illusion of Phenomenon manifesting itself in the Qualities is difficult to surmount. Only they who devote themselves to Me and to Me alone can accomplish it.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.15 The sinner, the ignorant, the vile, deprived of spiritual perception by the glamour of Illusion, and he who pursues a godless life - none of them shall find Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.16 O Arjuna! The righteous who worship Me are grouped by stages: first, they who suffer, next they who desire knowledge, then they who thirst after truth, and lastly they who attain wisdom.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.17 Of all of these, he who has gained wisdom, who meditates on Me without ceasing, devoting himself only to Me, he is the best; for by the wise man I am exceedingly beloved and the wise man, too, is beloved by Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.18 Noble-minded are they all, but the wise man I hold as my own Self; for he, remaining always at peace with Me, makes me his final goal.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.19 After many lives, at last the wise man realises Me as I am. A man so enlightened that he sees God everywhere is very difficult to find.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.20 They in whom wisdom is obscured by one desire or the other, worship the lesser Powers, practising many rites which vary according to their temperaments.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.21 But whatever the form of worship, if the devotee have faith, then upon his faith in that worship do I set My own seal.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.22 If he worships one form alone with real faith, then shall his desires be fulfilled through that only; for thus have I ordained.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.23 The fruit that comes to men of limited insight is, after all, finite. They who worship the Lower Powers attain them; but those who worship Me come unto Me alone.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.24 The ignorant think of Me, who am the Unmanifested Spirit, as if I were really in human form. They do not understand that My Superior Nature is changeless and most excellent.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.25 I am not visible to all, for I am enveloped by the illusion of Phenomenon. This deluded world does not know Me as the Unborn and the Imperishable.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.26 I know, O Arjuna, all beings in the past, the present and the future; but they do not know Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.27 O brave Arjuna! Man lives in a fairy world, deceived by the glamour of opposite sensations, infatuated by desire and aversion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.28 But those who act righteously, in whom sin has been destroyed, who are free from the infatuation of the conflicting emotions, they worship Me with firm resolution.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.29 Those who make Me their refuge, who strive for liberation from decay and Death, they realise the Supreme Spirit, which is their own real Self, and in which all action finds its consummation.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.30 Those who see Me in the life of the world, in the universal sacrifice, and as pure Divinity, keeping their minds steady, they live in Me, even in the crucial hour of death."

author: Shri Purohit Swami

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.3 The Lord Shri Krishna replied: The Supreme Spirit is the Highest Imperishable Self, and Its Nature is spiritual consciousness. The worlds have been created and are supported by an emanation from the Spirit which is called the Law.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.4 Matter consists of the forms that perish; Divinity is the Supreme Self; and He who inspires the spirit of sacrifice in man, O noblest of thy race, is I Myself, Who now stand in human form before thee.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.5 Whosoever at the time of death thinks only of Me, and thinking thus leaves the body and goes forth, assuredly he will know Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.6 On whatever sphere of being the mind of a man may be intent at the time of death, thither he will go.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.7 Therefore meditate always on Me, and fight; if thy mind and thy reason be fixed on Me, to Me shalt thou surely come.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.8 He whose mind does not wander, and who is engaged in constant meditation, attains the Supreme Spirit.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.9 Whoso meditates on the Omniscient, the Ancient, more minute than the atom, yet the Ruler and Upholder of all, Unimaginable, Brilliant like the Sun, Beyond the reach of darkness;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.10 He who leaves the body with mind unmoved and filled with devotion, by the power of his meditation gathering between his eyebrows his whole vital energy, attains the Supreme.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.11 Now I will speak briefly of the imperishable goal, proclaimed by those versed in the scriptures, which the mystic attains when free from passion, and for which he is content to undergo the vow of continence.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.12 Closing the gates of the body, drawing the forces of his mind into the heart and by the power of meditation concentrating his vital energy in the brain;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.13 Repeating Om, the Symbol of Eternity, holding Me always in remembrance, he who thus leaves his body and goes forth reaches the Spirit Supreme.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.14 To him who thinks constantly of Me, and of nothing else, to such an ever-faithful devotee, O Arjuna, am I ever accessible.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.15 Coming thus unto Me, these great souls go no more to the misery and death of earthly life, for they have gained perfection.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.16 The worlds, with the whole realm of creation, come and go; but, O Arjuna, whoso comes to Me, for him there is nor rebirth.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.17 Those who understand the cosmic day and cosmic night know that one day of creation is a thousand cycles, and that the night is of equal length.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.18 At the dawning of that day all objects in manifestation stream forth from the Unmanifest, and when evening falls they are dissolved into It again.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.19 The same multitude of beings, which have lived on earth so often, all are dissolved as the night of the universe approaches, to issue forth anew when morning breaks. Thus is it ordained.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.20 In truth, therefore, there is the Eternal Unmanifest, which is beyond and above the Unmanifest Spirit of Creation, which is never destroyed when all these being perish.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.21 The wise say that the Unmanifest and Indestructible is the highest goal of all; when once That is reached, there is no return. That is My Blessed Home.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.1 "Lord Shri Krishna said: I will now reveal to thee, since thou doubtest not, that profound mysticism, which when followed by experience, shall liberate thee from sin.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.2 This is the Premier Science, the Sovereign Secret, the Purest and Best; intuitional, righteous; and to him who practiseth it pleasant beyond measure.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.3 They who have no faith in this teaching cannot find Me, but remain lost in the purlieus of this perishable world.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.4 The whole world is pervaded by Me, yet My form is not seen. All living things have their being in Me, yet I am not limited by them.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.5 Nevertheless, they do not consciously abide in Me. Such is My Divine Sovereignty that though I, the Supreme Self, am the cause and upholder of all, yet I remain outside.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.6 As the mighty wind, though moving everywhere, has no resting place but space, so have all these beings no home but Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.7 All beings, O Arjuna, return at the close of every cosmic cycle into the realm of Nature, which is a part of Me, and at the beginning of the next I send them forth again.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.8 With the help of Nature, again and again I pour forth the whole multitude of beings, whether they will or no, for they are ruled by My Will.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.9 But these acts of mine do not bind Me. I remain outside and unattached.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.10 Under my guidance, Nature produces all things movable and immovable. Thus it is, O Arjuna, that this universe revolves.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.11 Fools disregard Me, seeing Me clad in human form. They know not that in My higher nature I am the Lord-God of all.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.12 Their hopes are vain, their actions worthless, their knowledge futile; they are without sense, deceitful, barbarous and godless.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.13 But the Great Souls, O Arjuna! Filled with My Divine Spirit, they worship Me, they fix their minds on Me and on Me alone, for they know that I am the imperishable Source of being.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.14 Always extolling Me, strenuous, firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before Me, they worship Me continually with concentrated devotion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.15 Others worship Me with full consciousness as the One, the Manifold, the Omnipresent, the Universal.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.16 I am the Oblation, the Sacrifice and the Worship; I am the Fuel and the Chant, I am the Butter offered to the fire, I am the Fire itself, and I am the Act of offering.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.17 I am the Father of the universe and its Mother; I am its Nourisher and its Grandfather; I am the Knowable and the Pure; I am Om; and I am the Sacred Scriptures.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.18 I am the Goal, the Sustainer, the Lord, the Witness, the Home, the Shelter, the Lover and the Origin; I am Life and Death; I am the Fountain and the Seed Imperishable.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.19 I am the Heat of the Sun, I release and hold back the Rains. I am Death and Immortality; I am Being and Not-Being.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.20 Those who are versed in the scriptures, who drink the mystic Soma-juice and are purified from sin, but who while worshipping Me with sacrifices pray that I will lead them to heaven; they reach the holy world where lives the Controller of the Powers of Nature, and they enjoy the feasts of Paradise.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.21 Yet although they enjoy the spacious glories of Paradise, nevertheless, when their merit is exhausted, they are born again into this world of mortals. They have followed the letter of the scriptures, yet because they have sought but to fulfill their own desires, they must depart and return again and again.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.22 But if a man will meditate on Me and Me alone, and will worship Me always and everywhere, I will take upon Myself the fulfillment of his aspiration, and I will safeguard whatsoever he shall attain.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.23 Even those who worship the lesser Powers, if they do so with faith, they thereby worship Me, though not in the right way.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.24 I am the willing recipient of sacrifice, and I am its true Lord. But these do not know me in truth, and so they sink back.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.25 The votaries of the lesser Powers go to them; the devotees of spirits go to them; they who worship the Powers of Darkness, to such Powers shall they go; and so, too, those who worship Me shall come to Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.26 Whatever a man offers to Me, whether it be a leaf, or a flower, or fruit, or water, I accept it, for it is offered with devotion and purity of mind.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.27 Whatever thou doest, whatever thou dost eat, whatever thou dost sacrifice and give, whatever austerities thou practisest, do all as an offering to Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.28 So shall thy action be attended by no result, either good or bad; but through the spirit of renunciation thou shalt come to Me and be free.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.29 I am the same to all beings. I favour none, and I hate none. But those who worship Me devotedly, they live in Me, and I in them.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.30 Even the most sinful, if he worship Me with his whole heart, shalt be considered righteous, for he is treading the right path.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.31 He shall attain spirituality ere long, and Eternal Peace shall be his. O Arjuna! Believe me, My devotee is never lost.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.32 For even the children of sinful parents, and those miscalled the weaker sex, and merchants, and labourers, if only they will make Me their refuge, they shall attain the Highest.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.33 What need then to mention the holy Ministers of God, the devotees and the saintly rulers? Do thou, therefore, born in this changing and miserable world, do thou too worship Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.34 Fix thy mind on Me, devote thyself to Me, sacrifice for Me, surrender to Me, make Me the object of thy aspirations, and thou shalt assuredly become one with Me, Who am thine own Self."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.1 "Lord Shri Krishna said: Now, O Prince! Listen to My supreme advice, which I give thee for the sake of thy welfare, for thou art My beloved.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.2 Neither the professors of divinity nor the great ascetics know My origin, for I am the source of them all.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.3 He who knows Me as the unborn, without beginning, the Lord of the universe, he, stripped of his delusion, becomes free from all conceivable sin.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.4 Intelligence, wisdom, non-illusion, forgiveness, truth, self-control, calmness, pleasure, pain, birth, death, fear and fearlessness;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.5 Harmlessness, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame and failure, all these, the characteristics of beings, spring from Me only.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.6 The seven Great Seers,* the Progenitors of mankind, the Ancient Four,** and the Lawgivers were born of My Will and come forth direct from Me. The race of mankind has sprung from them. [* Mareechi, Atri, Angira, Pulah, Kratu, Pulastya, Vahishta. ** The Masters: Sanak, Sanandan, Sanatan, Sanatkumar.]

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.7 He who rightly understands My manifested glory and My Creative Power, beyond doubt attains perfect peace.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.8 I am the source of all; from Me everything flows. Therefore the wise worship Me with unchanging devotion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.9 With minds concentrated on Me, with lives absorbed in Me, and enlightening each other, they ever feel content and happy.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.10 To those who are always devout and who worship Me with love, I give the power of discrimination, which leads them to Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.11 By My grace, I live in their hearts; and I dispel the darkness of ignorance by the shining light of wisdom.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.12 Arjuna asked: Thou art the Supreme Spirit, the Eternal Home, the Holiest of the Holy, the Eternal Divine Self, the Primal God, the Unborn and the Omnipresent.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.13 So have said the seers and the divine sage Narada; as well as Asita, Devala and Vyasa; and Thou Thyself also sayest it.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.14 I believe in what Thou hast said, my Lord! For neither the godly not the godless comprehend Thy manifestation.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Shri Purohit Swami did not comment on this sloka

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.16 Please tell me all about Thy glorious manifestations, by means of which Thou pervadest the world.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.17 O Master! How shall I, by constant meditation, know Thee? My Lord! What are Thy various manifestations through which I am to mediate on Thee?

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.18 Tell me again, I pray, about the fullness of Thy power and Thy glory; for I feel that I am never satisfied when I listen to Thy immortal words.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.19 Lord Shri Krishna replied: So be it, My beloved fried! I will unfold to thee some of the chief aspects of My glory. Of its full extent there is no end.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.20 O Arjuna! I am the Self, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning and the life, and I am the end of them all.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.21 Of all the creative Powers I am the Creator, of luminaries the Sun; the Whirlwind among the winds, and the Moon among planets.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.22 Of the Vedas I am the Hymns, I am the Electric Force in the Powers of Nature; of the senses I am the Mind; and I am the Intelligence in all that lives.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.23 Among Forces of Vitality I am the life, I am Mammon to the heathen and the godless; I am the Energy in fire, earth, wind, sky, heaven, sun, moon and planets; and among mountains am the Mount Meru.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.24 Among the priests, know, O Arjuna, that I am the Apostle Brihaspati; of generals I am Skanda, the Commander-in-Chief, and of waters I am the Ocean.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.25 Of the great seers I am Bhrigu, of words I am Om, of offerings I am the silent prayer, among things immovable I am the Himalayas.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.26 Of trees I am the sacred Fig-tree, of the Divine Seers Narada, of the heavenly singers I am Chitraratha, their Leader, and of sages I am Kapila.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.27 Know that among horses I am Pegasus, the heaven-born; among the lordly elephants I am the White one, and I am the Ruler among men.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.28 I am the Thunderbolt among weapons; of cows I am the Cow of Plenty, I am Passion in those who procreate, and I am the Cobra among serpents.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.29 I am the King-python among snakes, I am the Aqueous Principle among those that live in water, I am the Father of fathers, and among rulers I am Death.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.30 And I am the devotee Prahlad among the heathen; of Time I am the Eternal Present; I am the Lion among beasts and the Eagle among birds.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.31 I am the Wind among purifiers, the King Rama among warriors; I am the Crocodile among the fishes, and I am the Ganges among rivers.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.32 I am the Beginning, the Middle and the End in creation; among sciences, I am the science of Spirituality; I am the Discussion among disputants.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.33 Of letters I am A; I am the copulative in compound words; I am Time inexhaustible; and I am the all-pervading Preserver.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.34 I am all-devouring Death; I am the Origin of all that shall happen; I am Fame, Fortune, Speech, Memory, Intellect, Constancy and Forgiveness.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.35 Of hymns I am Brihatsama, of metres I am Garatri, among the months I am Margasheersha (December), and I am the Spring among seasons.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.36 I am the Gambling of the cheat and the Splendour of the splendid; I am Victory; I am Effort; and I am the Purity of the pure.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.37 I am Shri Krishna among the Vishnu-clan and Arjuna among the Pandavas; of the saints I am Vyasa, and I am Shukracharya among the sages.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.38 I am the Sceptre of rulers, the Strategy of the conquerors, the Silence of mystery, the Wisdom of the wise.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.39 I am the Seed of all being, O Arjuna! No creature moving or unmoving can live without Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.40 O Arjuna! The aspects of My divine life are endless. I have mentioned but a few by way of illustration.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.41 Whatever is glorious, excellent, beautiful and mighty, be assured that it comes from a fragment of My splendour.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.42 But what is the use of all these details to thee? O Arjuna! I sustain this universe with only small part of Myself."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.1 "Arjuna said: My Lord! Thy words concerning the Supreme Secret of Self, given for my blessing, have dispelled the illusions which surrounded me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.2 O Lord, whose eyes are like the lotus petal! Thou hast described in detail the origin and the dissolution of being, and Thine own Eternal Majesty.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.3 I believe all as Thou hast declared it. I long now to have a vision of thy Divine Form, O Thou Most High!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.4 If Thou thinkest that it can be made possible for me to see it, show me, O Lord of Lords, Thine own Eternal Self.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.5 Lord Shri Krishna replied: Behold, O Arjuna! My celestial forms, by hundred and thousands, various in kind, in colour and in shape.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.6 Behold thou the Powers of Nature: fire, earth, wind and sky; the sun, the heavens, the moon, the stars; all forces of vitality and of healing; and the roving winds. See the myriad wonders revealed to none but thee.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.7 Here in Me living as one, O Arjuna, behold the whole universe, movable and immovable, and anything else that thou wouldst see!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.8 Yet since with mortal eyes thou canst not see Me, lo! I give thee the Divine Sight. See now the glory of My Sovereignty."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.9 Sanjaya continued: "Having thus spoken, O King, the Lord Shri Krishna, the Almighty Prince of Wisdom, showed to Arjuna the Supreme Form of the Great God.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.10 There were countless eyes and mouths, and mystic forms innumerable, with shining ornaments and flaming celestial weapons.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.11 Crowned with heavenly garlands, clothed in shining garments, anointed with divine unctions, He showed Himself as the Resplendent One, Marvellous, Boundless, Omnipresent.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.12 Could a thousand suns blaze forth together it would be but a faint reflection of the radiance of the Lord God.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.13 In that vision Arjuna saw the universe, with its manifold shapes, all embraced in One, its Supreme Lord.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.14 Thereupon Arjuna, dumb with awe, his hair on end, his head bowed, his hands clasped in salutation, addressed the Lord thus:

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.15 Arjuna said: O almighty God! I see in Thee the powers of Nature, the various creatures of the world, the Progenitor on his lotus throne, the Sages and the shining angels.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.16 I see Thee, infinite in form, with, as it were, faces, eyes and limbs everywhere; no beginning, no middle, no end; O Thou Lord of the Universe, Whose Form is universal!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.17 I see thee with the crown, the sceptre and the discus; a blaze of splendour. Scarce can I gaze on thee, so radiant thou art, glowing like the blazing fire, brilliant as the sun, immeasurable.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.18 Imperishable art Thou, the Sole One worthy to be known, the priceless Treasure-house of the universe, the immortal Guardian of the Life Eternal, the Spirit Everlasting.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.19 Without beginning, without middle and without end, infinite in power, Thine arms all-embracing, the sun and moon Thine eyes, Thy face beaming with the fire of sacrifice, flooding the whole universe with light.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.20 Alone thou fillest all the quarters of the sky, earth and heaven, and the regions between. O Almighty Lord! Seeing Thy marvellous and awe-inspiring Form, the spheres tremble with fear.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.21 The troops of celestial beings enter into Thee, some invoking Thee in fear, with folded palms; the Great Seers and Adepts sing hymns to Thy Glory, saying All Hail.'

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.22 The Vital Forces, the Major stars, Fire, Earth, Air, Sky, Sun, Heaven, Moon and Planets; the Angels, the Guardians of the Universe, the divine Healers, the Winds, the Fathers, the Heavenly Singers; and hosts of Mammon-worshippers, demons as well as saints, are amazed.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.23 Seeing Thy stupendous Form, O Most Mighty, with its myriad faces, its innumerable eyes and limbs and terrible jaws, I myself and all the worlds are overwhelmed with awe.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.24 When I see Thee, touching the Heavens, glowing with colour, with open mouth and wide open fiery eyes, I am terrified. O My Lord! My courage and peace of mind desert me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.25 When I see Thy mouths with their fearful jaws like glowing fires at the dissolution of creation, I lose all sense of place; I find no rest. Be merciful, O Lord in whom this universe abides!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.26 All these sons of Dhritarashtra, with the hosts of princes, Bheeshma, Drona and Karna, as well as the other warrior chiefs belonging to our side;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.27 1 see them all rushing headlong into Thy mouths, with terrible tusks, horrible to behold. Some are mangled between thy jaws, with their heads crushed to atoms.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.28 As rivers in flood surge furiously to the ocean, so these heroes, the greatest among men, fling themselves into Thy flaming mouths.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.29 As moths fly impetuously to the flame only to be killed, so these men rush into Thy mouths to court their own destruction.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.30 Thou seemest to swallow up the worlds, to lap them in flame. Thy glory fills the universe. Thy fierce rays beat down upon it irresistibly.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.31 Tell me then who Thou art, that wearest this dreadful Form? I bow before Thee, O Mighty One! Have mercy, I pray, and let me see Thee as Thou wert at first. I do not know what Thou intendest.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.32 Lord Shri Krishna replied: I have shown myself to thee as the Destroyer who lays waste the world and whose purpose is destruction. In spite of thy efforts, all these warriors gathered for battle shall not escape death.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.33 Then gird up thy loins and conquer. Subdue thy foes and enjoy the kingdom in prosperity. I have already doomed them. Be thou my instrument, Arjuna!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.34 Drona and Bheeshma, Jayadratha and Karna, and other brave warriors - I have condemned them all. Destroy them; fight and fear not. Thy foes shall be crushed."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.35 Sanjaya continued: "Having heard these words from the Lord Shri Krishna, the Prince Arjuna, with folded hands trembling, prostrated himself and with choking voice, bowing down again and again, and overwhelmed with awe, once more addressed the Lord.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.36 Arjuna said: My Lord! It is natural that the world revels and rejoices when it sings the praises of Thy glory; the demons fly in fear and the saints offer Thee their salutations.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.37 How should they do otherwise? O Thou Supremest Self, greater than the Powers of creation, the First Cause, Infinite, the Lord of Lords, the Home of the universe, Imperishable, Being and Not-Being, yet transcending both.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.38 Thou art the Primal God, the Ancient, the Supreme Abode of this universe, the Knower, the Knowledge and the Final Home. Thou fillest everything. Thy form is infinite.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.39 Thou art the Wind, Thou art Death, Thou art the Fire, the Water, the Moon, the Father and the Grandfather. Honour and glory to Thee a thousand and a thousand times! Again and again, salutation be to Thee, O my Lord!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.40 Salutations to Thee in front and on every side, Thou who encompasseth me round about. Thy power is infinite; Thy majesty immeasurable; thou upholdest all things; yea,Thou Thyself art All.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.41 Whatever I have said unto Thee in rashness, taking Thee only for a friend and addressing Thee as O Krishna! O Yadava! O Friend!' in thoughtless familiarity, no understanding Thy greatness;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.42 Whatever insult I have offered to Thee in jest, in sport or in repose, in conversation or at the banquet, alone or in a multitude, I ask Thy forgiveness for them all, O Thou Who art without an equal!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.43 For Thou art the Father of all things movable and immovable, the Worshipful, the Master of Masters! In all the worlds there is none equal to Thee, how then superior, O Thou who standeth alone, Supreme.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.44 Therefore I prostrate myself before Thee, O Lord! Most Adorable! I salute Thee, I ask Thy blessing. Only Thou canst be trusted to bear with me, as father to son, as friend to friend, as lover to his beloved.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.45 I rejoice that I have seen what never man saw before; yet, O Lord! I am overwhelmed with fear. Please take again the Form I know. Be merciful, O Lord! thou Who are the Home of the whole universe.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.46 I long to see Thee as thou wert before, with the crown, the sceptre and the discus in Thy hands; in Thy other Form, with Thy four hands, O Thou Whose arms are countless and Whose forms are infinite.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.47 Lord Shri Krishna replied: My beloved friend! It is only through My grace and power that thou hast been able to see this vision of splendour, the Universal, the Infinite, the Original. Never has it been seen by any but thee.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.48 Not by study of the scriptures, not by sacrifice or gift, not by ritual or rigorous austerity, is it possible for man on earth to see what thou hast seen, O thou foremost hero of the Kuru-clan!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.49 Be not afraid or bewildered by the terrible vision. Put away thy fear and, with joyful mind, see Me once again in My usual Form."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.50 Sanjaya continued: "Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Lord Shri Krishna showed Himself again in His accustomed form; and the Mighty Lord, in gentle tones, softly consoled him who lately trembled with fear.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.51 Arjuna said: Seeing Thee in Thy gentle human form, my Lord, I am myself again, calm once more.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.52 Lord Shri Krishna replied: It is hard to see this vision of Me that thou hast seen. Even the most powerful have longed for it in vain.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.53 Not by study of the scriptures, or by austerities, not by gifts or sacrifices, is it possible to see Me as thou hast done.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.54 Only by tireless devotion can I be seen and known; only thus can a man become one with Me, O Arjuna!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.55 He whose every action is done for My sake, to whom I am the final goal, who loves Me only and hates no one - O My dearest son, only he can realize Me!"

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.1 "Arjuna asked: My Lord! Which are the better devotees who worship Thee, those who try to know Thee as a Personal God, or those who worship Thee as Impersonal and Indestructible?

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.2 Lord Shri Krishna replied: Those who keep their minds fixed on Me, who worship Me always with unwavering faith and concentration; these are the very best.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Shri Purohit Swami did not comment on this sloka

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.4 Subduing their senses, viewing all conditions of life with the same eye, and working for the welfare of all beings, assuredly they come to Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.5 But they who thus fix their attention on the Absolute and Impersonal encounter greater hardships, for it is difficult for those who possess a body to realise Me as without one.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.6 Verily, those who surrender their actions to Me, who muse on Me, worship Me and meditate on Me alone, with no thought save of Me,

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.7 O Arjuna! I rescue them from the ocean of life and death, for their minds are fixed on Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.8 Then let thy mind cling only to Me, let thy intellect abide in Me; and without doubt thou shalt live hereafter in Me alone.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.9 But if thou canst not fix thy mind firmly on Me, then, My beloved friend, try to do so by constant practice.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.10 And if thou are not strong enough to practise concentration, then devote thyself to My service, do all thine acts for My sake, and thou shalt still attain the goal.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.11 And if thou art too weak even for this, then seek refuge in union with Me, and with perfect self-control renounce the fruit of thy action.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.12 Knowledge is superior to blind action, meditation to mere knowledge, renunciation of the fruit of action to meditation, and where there is renunciation peace will follow.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.13 He who is incapable of hatred towards any being, who is kind and compassionate, free from selfishness, without pride, equable in pleasure and in pain, and forgiving,

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.14 Always contented, self-centred, self-controlled, resolute, with mind and reason dedicated to Me, such a devotee of Mine is My beloved.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.15 He who does not harm the world, and whom the world cannot harm, who is not carried away by any impulse of joy, anger or fear, such a one is My beloved.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.16 He who expects nothing, who is pure, watchful, indifferent, unruffled, and who renounces all initiative, such a one is My beloved.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.17 He who is beyond joy and hate, who neither laments nor desires, to whom good and evil fortunes are the same, such a one is My beloved.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Shri Purohit Swami did not comment on this sloka

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.19 Who is indifferent to praise and censure, who enjoys silence, who is contented with every fate, who has no fixed abode, who is steadfast in mind, and filled with devotion, such a one is My beloved.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.20 Verily those who love the spiritual wisdom as I have taught, whose faith never fails, and who concentrate their whole nature on Me, they indeed are My most beloved."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.2 Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Arjuna! The body of man is the playground of the Self; and That which knows the activities of Matter, sages call the Self.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.3 I am the Omniscient self that abides in the playground of Matter; knowledge of Matter and of the all-knowing Self is wisdom.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.4 What is called Matter, of what it is composed, whence it came, and why it changes, what the Self is, and what Its power - this I will now briefly set forth.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.5 Seers have sung of It in various ways, in many hymns and sacred Vedic songs, weighty in thought and convincing in argument.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.6 The five great fundamentals (earth, fire, air, water and ether), personality, intellect, the mysterious life force, the ten organs of perception and action, the mind and the five domains of sensation;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.7 Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, sympathy, vitality and the persistent clinging to life, these are in brief the constituents of changing Matter.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.8 Humility, sincerity, harmlessness, forgiveness, rectitude, service of the Master, purity, steadfastness, self-control;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.9 Renunciation of the delights of sense, absence of pride, right understanding of the painful problem of birth and death, of age and sickness;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.10 Indifference, non-attachment to sex, progeny or home, equanimity in good fortune and in bad;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.11 Unswerving devotion to Me, by concentration on Me and Me alone, a love for solitude, indifference to social life;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.12 Constant yearning for the knowledge of Self, and pondering over the lessons of the great Truth - this is Wisdom, all else ignorance.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.13 I will speak to thee now of that great Truth which man ought to know, since by its means he will win immortal bliss - that which is without beginning, the Eternal Spirit which dwells in Me, neither with form, nor yet without it.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.14 Everywhere are Its hands and Its feet; everywhere It has eyes that see, heads that think and mouths that speak; everywhere It listens; It dwells in all the worlds; It envelops them all.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.15 Beyond the senses, It yet shines through every sense perception. Bound to nothing, It yet sustains everything. Unaffected by the Qualities, It still enjoys them all.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.16 It is within all beings, yet outside; motionless yet moving; too subtle to be perceived; far away yet always near.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.17 In all beings undivided, yet living in division, It is the upholder of all, Creator and Destroyer alike;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.18 It is the Light of lights, beyond the reach of darkness; the Wisdom, the only thing that is worth knowing or that wisdom can teach; the Presence in the hearts of all.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.19 Thus I have told thee in brief what Matter is, and the Self worth realising and what is Wisdom. He who is devoted to Me knows; and assuredly he will enter into Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.20 Know thou further that Nature and God have no beginning; and that differences of character and quality have their origin in Nature only.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.21 Nature is the Law which generates cause and effect; God is the source of the enjoyment of all pleasure and pain.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.22 God dwelling in the heart of Nature experiences the Qualities which nature brings forth; and His affinity towards the Qualities is the reason for His living in a good or evil body.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.23 Thus in the body of man dwells the Supreme God; He who sees and permits, upholds and enjoys, the Highest God and the Highest Self.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.24 He who understands God and Nature along with her qualities, whatever be his condition in life, he comes not again to earth.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.25 Some realise the Supreme by meditating, by its aid, on the Self within, others by pure reason, others by right action.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.26 Others again, having no direct knowledge but only hearing from others, nevertheless worship, and they, too, if true to the teachings, cross the sea of death.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.27 Wherever life is seen in things movable or immovable, it is the joint product of Matter and Spirit.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.28 He who can see the Supreme Lord in all beings, the Imperishable amidst the perishable, he it is who really sees.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.29 Beholding the Lord in all things equally, his actions do not mar his spiritual life but lead him to the height of Bliss.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.30 He who understands that it is only the Law of Nature that brings action to fruition, and that the Self never acts, alone knows the Truth.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.31 He who sees the diverse forms of life all rooted in One, and growing forth from Him, he shall indeed find the Absolute.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.32 The Supreme Spirit, O Prince, is without beginning, without Qualities and Imperishable, and though it be within the body, yet It does not act, nor is It affected by action.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.33 As space, though present everywhere, remains by reason of its subtlety unaffected, so the Self, though present in all forms, retains its purity unalloyed.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.34 As the one Sun illuminates the whole earth, so the Lord illumines the whole universe.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
