content: 13.35 Those who with the eyes of wisdom thus see the difference between Matter and Spirit, and know how to liberate Life from the Law of Nature, they attain the Supreme."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.1 "Lord Shri Krishna continued: Now I will reveal unto the Wisdom which is beyond knowledge, by attaining which the sages have reached Perfection.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.2 Dwelling in Wisdom and realising My Divinity, they are not born again when the universe is re-created at the beginning of every cycle, nor are they affected when it is dissolved.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.3 The eternal Cosmos is My womb, in which I plant the seed, from which all beings are born, O Prince!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.4 O illustrious son of Kunti! Through whatever wombs men are born, it is the Spirit Itself that conceives, and I am their Father.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.5 Purity, Passion and Ignorance are the Qualities which the Law of nature bringeth forth. They fetter the free Spirit in all beings.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.6 O Sinless One! Of these, Purity, being luminous, strong and invulnerable, binds one by its yearning for happiness and illumination.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.7 Passion, engendered by thirst for pleasure and attachment, binds the soul through its fondness for activity.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.8 But Ignorance, the product of darkness, stupefies the senses in all embodied beings, binding them by chains of folly, indolence and lethargy.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.9 Purity brings happiness, Passion commotion, and Ignorance, which obscures wisdom, leads to a life of failure.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.10 O Prince! Purity prevails when Passion and Ignorance are overcome; Passion, when Purity and Ignorance are overcome; and Ignorance when it overcomes Purity and Passion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.11 When the light of knowledge gleams forth from all the gates of the body, then be sure that Purity prevails.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.12 O best of Indians! Avarice, the impulse to act and the beginning of action itself are all due to the dominance of Passion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.13 Darkness, stagnation, folly and infatuation are the result of the dominance of Ignorance, O joy of the Kuru-clan!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.14 When Purity prevails, the soul on quitting the body passes on to the pure regions where live those who know the Highest.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.15 When Passion prevails, the soul is reborn among those who love activity; when Ignorance rules, it enters the wombs of the ignorant.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.16 They say the fruit of a meritorious action is spotless and full of purity; the outcome of Passion is misery, and of Ignorance darkness.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.17 Purity engenders Wisdom, Passion avarice, and Ignorance folly, infatuation and darkness.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.18 When Purity is in the ascendant, the man evolves; when Passion, he neither evolves nor degenerates; when Ignorance, he is lost.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.19 As soon as man understands that it is only the Qualities which act and nothing else, and perceives That which is beyond, he attains My divine nature.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.20 When the soul transcends the Qualities, which are the real cause of physical existence, then, freed from birth and death, from old age and misery, he quaffs the nectar of immortality.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.21 Arjuna asked: My Lord! By what signs can he who has transcended the Qualities be recognized? How does he act? How does he live beyond them?

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.22 Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Prince! He who shuns not the Quality which is present, and longs not for that which is absent;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.23 He who maintains an attitude of indifference, who is not disturbed by the Qualities, who realises that it is only they who act, and remains calm;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.24 Who accepts pain and pleasure as it comes, is centred in his Self, to whom a piece of clay or stone or gold are the same, who neither likes nor dislikes, who is steadfast, indifferent alike to praise or censure;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.25 Who looks equally upon honour and dishonour, loves friends and foes alike, abandons all initiative, such is he who transcends the Qualities.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.26 And he who serves Me and only Me, with unfaltering devotion, shall overcome the Qualities, and become One with the Eternal.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.27 For I am the Home of the Spirit, the continual Source of immortality, of eternal Righteousness and of infinite Joy."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.1 "Lord Shri Krishna continued: This phenomenal creation, which is both ephemeral and eternal, is like a tree, but having its seed above in the Highest and its ramifications on this earth below. The scriptures are its leaves, and he who understands this, knows.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.2 Its branches shoot upwards and downwards, deriving their nourishment from the Qualities; its buds are the objects of sense; and its roots, which follow the Law causing man's regeneration and degeneration, pierce downwards into the soil.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.3 In this world its true form is not known, neither its origin nor its end, and its strength is not understood., until the tree with its roots striking deep into the earth is hewn down by the sharp axe of non-attachment.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.4 Beyond lies the Path, from which, when found, there is no return. This is the Primal God from whence this ancient creation has sprung.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.5 The wise attain Eternity when, freed from pride and delusion, they have conquered their love for the things of sense; when, renouncing desire and fixing their gaze on the Self, they have ceased to be tossed to and fro by the opposing sensations, like pleasure and pain.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.6 Neither sun, moon, nor fire shines there. Those who go thither never come back. For, O Arjuna, that is my Celestial Home!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.7 It is only a very small part of My Eternal Self, which is the life of the universe, drawing round itself the six senses, the mind the last, which have their source in Nature.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.8 When the Supreme Lord enters a body or leaves it, He gathers these senses together and travels on with them, as the wind gathers perfume while passing through the flowers.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.9 He is the perception of the ear, the eye, the touch, the taste and the smell, yea and of the mind also; and the enjoyment the things which they perceive is also His.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.10 The ignorant do not see that it is He Who is present in life and Who departs at death or even that it is He Who enjoys pleasure through the Qualities. Only the eye of wisdom sees.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.11 The saints with great effort find Him within themselves; but not the unintelligent, who in spite of every effort cannot control their minds.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.12 Remember that the Light which, proceeding from the sun, illumines the whole world, and the Light which is in the moon, and That which is in the fire also, all are born of Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.13 1 enter this world and animate all My creatures with My vitality; and by My cool moonbeams I nourish the plants.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.14 Becoming the fire of life, I pass into their bodies and, uniting with the vital streams of Prana and Apana, I digest the various kinds of food.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.15 I am enthroned in the hearts of all; memory, wisdom and discrimination owe their origins to Me. I am He Who is to be realised in the scriptures; I inspire their wisdom and I know their truth.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.16 There are two aspects in Nature: the perishable and the imperishable. All life in this world belongs to the former, the unchanging element belongs to the latter.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.17 But higher than all am I, the Supreme God, the Absolute Self, the Eternal Lord, Who pervades the worlds and upholds them all.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.18 Beyond comparison of the Eternal with the non-eternal am I, Who am called by scriptures and sages the Supreme Personality, the Highest God.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.19 He who with unclouded vision sees Me as the Lord-God, knows all there is to be known, and always shall worship Me with his whole heart.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.20 Thus, O Sinless One, I have revealed to thee this most mystic knowledge. He who understands gains wisdom and attains the consummation of life."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.1 "Lord Shri Krishna continued: Fearlessness, clean living, unceasing concentration on wisdom, readiness to give, self-control, a spirit of sacrifice, regular study of the scriptures, austerities, candour,

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.2 harmlessness, truth, absence of wrath, renunciation, contentment, straightforwardness, compassion towards all, uncovetousness, courtesy, modesty, constancy,

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.3 Valour, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, freedom from hate and vanity; these are his who possesses the Godly Qualities, O Arjuna!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.4 Hypocrisy, pride, insolence, cruelty, ignorance belong to him who is born of the godless qualities.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.5 Godly qualities lead to liberation; godless to bondage. Do not be anxious, Prince! Thou hast the Godly qualities.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.6 All beings are of two classes: Godly and godless. The Godly I have described; I will now describe the other.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.7 The godless do not know how to act or how to renounce. They have neither purity nor truth. They do not understand the right principles of conduct.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.8 They say the universe is an accident with no purpose and no God. Life is created by sexual union, a product of lust and nothing else.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.9 Thinking thus, these degraded souls, these enemies of mankind - whose intelligence is negligible and whose deeds are monstrous - come into the world only to destroy.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.10 Giving themselves up to insatiable passions, hypocritical, self-sufficient and arrogant, cherishing false conception founded on delusion, they work only to carry out their own unholy purposes.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.11 Poring anxiously over evil resolutions, which only end in death; seeking only the gratification of desire as the highest goal; seeing nothing beyond;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.12 Caught in the toils of a hundred vain hopes, the slaves of passion and wrath, they accumulate hoards of unjust wealth, only to pander to their sensual desire.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.13 This I have gained today; tomorrow I will gratify another desire; this wealth is mine now, the rest shall be mine ere long;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.14 I have slain one enemy, I will slay the others also; I am worthy to enjoy, I am the Almighty, I am perfect, powerful and happy;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.15 I am rich, I am well-bred; who is there to compare with me? I will sacrifice, I will give, I will pay - and I will enjoy. Thus blinded by Ignorance,

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.16 Perplexed by discordant thoughts, entangled in the snares of desire, infatuated by passion, they sink into the horrors of hell.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.17 Self-conceited, stubborn, rich, proud and insolent, they make a display of their patronage, disregarding the rules of decency.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.18 Puffed up by power and inordinate conceit, swayed by lust and wrath, these wicked people hate Me Who am within them, as I am within all.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.19 Those who thus hate Me, who are cruel, the dregs of mankind, I condemn them to a continuous, miserable and godless rebirth.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.20 So reborn, they spend life after life, enveloped in delusion. And they never reach Me, O Prince, but degenerate into still lower forms of life.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.21 The gates of hell are three: lust, wrath and avarice. They destroy the Self. Avoid them.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.22 These are the gates which lead to darkness; if a man avoid them he will ensure his own welfare, and in the end will attain his liberation.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.23 But he who neglects the commands of the scriptures, and follows the promptings of passion, he does not attain perfection, happiness or the final goal.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.24 Therefore whenever there is doubt whether thou shouldst do a thing or not, let the scriptures guide thy conduct. In the light of the scriptures shouldst thou labour the whole of thy life."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.1 "Arjuna asked: My Lord! Those who do acts of sacrifice, not according to the scriptures but nevertheless with implicit faith, what is their condition? Is it one of Purity, of Passion or of Ignorance?

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.2 Lord Shri Krishna replied: Man has an inherent faith in one or another of the Qualities -Purity, Passion and Ignorance. Now listen.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.3 The faith of every man conforms to his nature. By nature he is full of faith. He is in fact what his faith makes him.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.4 The Pure worship the true God; the Passionate, the powers of wealth and magic; the Ignorant, the spirits of the dead and of the lower orders of nature.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.5 Those who practise austerities not commanded by scripture, who are slaves to hypocrisy and egotism, who are carried away by the fury of desire and passion,

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.6 They are ignorant. They torment the organs of the body; and they harass Me also, Who lives within. Know that they are devoted to evil.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.7 The food which men enjoy is also threefold, like the ways of sacrifice, austerity and almsgiving. Listen to the distinction.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.8 The foods that prolong life and increase purity, vigour, health, cheerfulness and happiness are those that are delicious, soothing, substantial and agreeable. These are loved by the Pure.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.9 Those in whom Passion is dominant like foods that are bitter, sour, salty, over-hot, pungent, dry and burning. These produce unhappiness, repentance and disease.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.10 The Ignorant love food which is stale, not nourishing, putrid and corrupt, the leavings of others and unclean.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.11 Sacrifice is Pure when it is offered by one who does not covet the fruit thereof, when it is done according to the commands of scripture, and with implicit faith that the sacrifice is a duty.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.12 Sacrifice which is performed for the sake of its results, or for self-glorification - that, O best of Aryans, is the product of Passion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.13 Sacrifice that is contrary to scriptural command, that is unaccompanied by prayers or gifts of food or money, and is without faith - that is the product of Ignorance.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.14 Worship of God and the Master; respect for the preacher and the philosopher; purity, rectitude, continence and harmlessness - all this is physical austerity.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.15 Speech that hurts no one, that is true, is pleasant to listen to and beneficial, and the constant study of the scriptures - this is austerity in speech.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.16 Serenity, kindness, silence, self-control and purity - this is austerity of mind.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.17 These threefold austerities performed with faith, and without thought of reward, may truly be accounted Pure.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.18 Austerity coupled with hypocrisy or performed for the sake of self-glorification, popularity or vanity, comes from Passion, and its result is always doubtful and temporary.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.19 Austerity done under delusion, and accompanied with sorcery or torture to oneself or another, may be assumed to spring from Ignorance.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.20 The gift which is given without thought of recompense, in the belief that it ought to be made, in a fit place, at an opportune time and to a deserving person - such a gift is Pure.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.21 That which is given for the sake of the results it will produce, or with the hope of recompense,or grudgingly - that may truly be said to be the outcome of Passion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.22 And that which is given at an unsuitable place or time or to one who is unworthy, or with disrespect or contempt - such a gift is the result of Ignorance.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.23 Om Tat Sat' is the triple designation of the Eternal Spirit, by which of old the Vedic Scriptures, the ceremonials and the sacrifices were ordained.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.24 Therefore all acts of sacrifice, gifts and austerities, prescribed by the scriptures, are always begun by those who understand the Spirit with the word Om.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.25 Those who desire deliverance begin their acts of sacrifice, austerity or gift with the word Tat' (meaning That'), without thought of reward.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.26 Sat' means Reality or the highest Good, and also, O Arjuna, it is used to mean an action of exceptional merit.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.27 Conviction in sacrifice, in austerity and in giving is also called Sat.' So too an action done only for the Lord's sake.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.28 Whatsoever is done without faith, whether it be sacrifice, austerity or gift or anything else, as called Asat' (meaning Unreal') for it is the negation of Sat,' O Arjuna! Such an act has no significance, here or hereafter."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.1 "Arjuna asked: O mighty One! I desire to know how relinquishment is distinguished from renunciation.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.2 Lord Shri Krishna replied: The sages say that renunciation means forgoing an action which springs from desire; and relinquishing means the surrender of its fruit.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.3 Some philosophers say that all action is evil and should be abandoned. Others that acts of sacrifice, benevolence and austerity should not be given up.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.4 O best of Indians! Listen to my judgment as regards this problem. It has a threefold aspect.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.5 Acts of sacrifice, benevolence and austerity should not be given up but should be performed, for they purify the aspiring soul.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.6 But they should be done with detachment and without thought of recompense. This is my final judgment.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.7 It is not right to give up actions which are obligatory; and if they are misunderstood, it is the result of sheer ignorance.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.8 To avoid an action through fear of physical suffering, because it is likely to be painful, is to act from passion, and the benefit of renunciation will not follow.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.9 He who performs an obligatory action, because he believes it to be a duty which ought to be done, without any personal desire to do the act or to receive any return - such renunciation is Pure.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.10 The wise man who has attained purity, whose doubts are solved, who is filled with the spirit of self-abnegation, does not shrink from action because it brings pain, nor does he desire it because it brings pleasure.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.11 But since those still in the body cannot entirely avoid action, in their case abandonment of the fruit of action is considered as complete renunciation.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.12 For those who cannot renounce all desire, the fruit of action hereafter is threefold - good, evil, and partly good and partly evil. But for him who has renounced, there is none.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.13 I will tell thee now, O Mighty Man, the five causes which, according to the final decision of philosophy, must concur before an action can be accomplished.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.14 They are a body, a personality, physical organs, their manifold activity and destiny.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.15 Whatever action a man performs, whether by muscular effort or by speech or by thought, and whether it be right or wrong, these five are the essential causes.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.16 But the fool who supposes, because of his immature judgment, that it is his own Self alone that acts, he perverts the truth and does not see rightly.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.17 He who has no pride, and whose intellect is unalloyed by attachment, even though he kill these people, yet he does not kill them, and his act does not bind him.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.18 Knowledge, the knower and the object of knowledge, these are the three incentives to action; and the act, the actor and the instrument are the threefold constituents.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.19 The knowledge, the act and the doer differ according to the Qualities. Listen to this too:

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.20 That knowledge which sees the One Indestructible in all beings, the One Indivisible in all separate lives, may be truly called Pure Knowledge.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.21 The knowledge which thinks of the manifold existence in all beings as separate - that comes from Passion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.22 But that which clings blindly to one idea as if it were all, without logic, truth or insight, that has its origin in Darkness.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.23 An obligatory action done by one who is disinterested, who neither likes nor dislikes it, and gives no thought to the consequences that follow, such an action is Pure.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.24 But even though an action involve the most strenuous endeavour, yet if the doer is seeking to gratify his desires, and is filled with personal vanity, it may be assumed to originate in Passion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.25 An action undertaken through delusion, and with no regard to the spiritual issues involved, or the real capacity of the doer, or to the injury which may follow, such an act may be assumed to be the product of Ignorance.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.26 But when a man has no sentiment and no personal vanity, when he possesses courage and confidence, cares not whether he succeeds or fails, then his action arises from Purity.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.27 In him who is impulsive, greedy, looking for reward, violent, impure, torn between joy and sorrow,it may be assumed that in him Passion is predominant.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.28 While he whose purpose is infirm, who is low-minded, stubborn, dishonest, malicious, indolent, despondent, procrastinating - he may be assumed to be in Darkness.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.29 Reason and conviction are threefold, according to the Quality which is dominant. I will explain them fully and severally, O Arjuna!

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.30 That intellect which understands the creation and dissolution of life, what actions should be done and what not, which discriminates between fear and fearlessness, bondage and deliverance, that is Pure.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.31 The intellect which does not understand what is right and what is wrong, and what should be done and what not, is under the sway of Passion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.32 And that which, shrouded in Ignorance, thinks wrong right, and sees everything perversely, O Arjuna, that intellect is ruled by Darkness.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.33 The conviction and steady concentration by which the mind, the vitality and the senses are controlled - O Arjuna! They are the product of Purity.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.34 The conviction which always holds fast to rituals, to self-interest and wealth, for the sake of what they may bring forth - that comes from Passion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.35 And that which clings perversely to false idealism, fear, grief, despair and vanity is the product of Ignorance.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.36 Hear further the three kinds of pleasure. That which increases day after day delivers one from misery,

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.37 Which at first seems like poison but afterwards acts like nectar - that pleasure is Pure, for it is born of Wisdom.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.38 That which as first is like nectar, because the senses revel in their objects, but in the end acts like poison - that pleasure arises from Passion.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.39 While the pleasure which from first to last merely drugs the senses, which springs from indolence, lethargy and folly - that pleasure flows from Ignorance.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.40 There is nothing anywhere on earth or in the higher worlds which is free from the three Qualities - for they are born of Nature.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.41 O Arjuna! The duties of spiritual teachers, the soldiers, the traders and the servants have all been fixed according to the dominant Quality in their nature.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.42 Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness, as well as uprightness, knowledge, wisdom and faith in God - these constitute the duty of a spiritual Teacher.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.43 Valour, glory, firmness, skill, generosity, steadiness in battle and ability to rule - these constitute the duty of a soldier. They flow from his own nature.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.44 Agriculture, protection of the cow and trade are the duty of a trader, again in accordance with his nature. The duty of a servant is to serve, and that too agrees with his nature.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 5.10 He who dedicates his actions to the Spirit, without any personal attachment to them, he is no more tainted by sin than the water lily is wetted by water.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.46 Man reaches perfection by dedicating his actions to God, Who is the source of all being, and fills everything.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.47 It is better to do one's own duty, however defective it may be, than to follow the duty of another, however well one may perform it. He who does his duty as his own nature reveals it, never sins.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.48 The duty that of itself falls to one's lot should not be abandoned, though it may have its defects. All acts are marred by defects, as fire is obscured by smoke.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.49 He whose mind is entirely detached, who has conquered himself, whose desires have vanished, by his renunciation reaches that stage of perfect freedom where action completes itself and leaves no seed.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.50 I will now state briefly how he, who has reached perfection, finds the Eternal Spirit, the state of Supreme Wisdom.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.51 Guided always by pure reason, bravely restraining himself, renouncing the objects of sense and giving up attachment and hatred;

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.52 Enjoying solitude, abstemiousness, his body, mind and speech under perfect control, absorbed in meditation, he becomes free - always filled with the spirit of renunciation.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.53 Having abandoned selfishness, power, arrogance, anger and desire, possessing nothing of his own and having attained peace, he is fit to join the Eternal Spirit.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.54 And when he becomes one with the Eternal, and his soul knows the bliss that belongs to the Self, he feels no desire and no regret, he regards all beings equally and enjoys the blessing of supreme devotion to Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.55 By such devotion, he sees Me, who I am and what I am; and thus realising the Truth, he enters My Kingdom.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.56 Relying on Me in all his action and doing them for My sake, he attains, by My Grace, Eternal and Unchangeable Life.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.57 Surrender then thy actions unto Me, live in Me, concentrate thine intellect on Me, and think always of Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.58 Fix but thy mind on Me, and by My grace thou shalt overcome the obstacles in thy path. But if, misled by pride, thou wilt not listen, then indeed thou shalt be lost.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.59 If thou in thy vanity thinkest of avoiding this fight, thy will shall not be fulfilled, for Nature herself will compel thee.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.60 O Arjuna! Thy duty binds thee. From thine own nature has it arisen, and that which in thy delusion thou desire not to do, that very thing thou shalt do. Thou art helpless.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.61 God dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna! He causes them to revolve as it were on a wheel by His mystic power.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.62 With all thy strength, fly unto Him and surrender thyself, and by His grace shalt thou attain Supreme Peace and reach the Eternal Home.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.63 Thus have I revealed to thee the Truth, the Mystery of mysteries. Having thought it over, thou art free to act as thou wilt.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.64 Only listen once more to My last word, the deepest secret of all; thou art My beloved, thou are My friend, and I speak for thy welfare.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.65 Dedicate thyself to Me, worship Me, sacrifice all for Me, prostrate thyself before Me, and to Me thou shalt surely come. Truly do I pledge thee; thou art My own beloved.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.66 Give up then thy earthly duties, surrender thyself to Me only. Do not be anxious; I will absolve thee from all thy sin.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.67 Speak not this to one who has not practised austerities, or to him who does not love, or who will not listen, or who mocks.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.68 But he who teaches this great secret to My devotees, his is the highest devotion, and verily he shall come unto Me.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.69 Nor is there among men any who can perform a service dearer to Me than this, or any man on earth more beloved by Me than he.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.70 He who will study this spiritual discourse of ours, I assure thee, he shall thereby worship Me at the altar of Wisdom.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.71 Yea, he who listens to it with faith and without doubt, even he, freed from evil, shalt rise to the worlds which the virtuous attain through righteous deeds.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.72 O Arjuna! Hast thou listened attentively to My words? Has thy ignorance and thy delusion gone?

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.73 Arjuna replied: My Lord! O Immutable One! My delusion has fled. By Thy Grace, O Changeless One, the light has dawned. My doubts are gone, and I stand before Thee ready to do Thy will."

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.74 Sanjaya told: "Thus have I heard this rare, wonderful and soul-stirring discourse of the Lord Shri Krishna and the great-souled Arjuna.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.75 Through the blessing of the sage Vyasa, I listened to this secret and noble science from the lips of its Master, the Lord Shri Krishna.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.76 O King! The more I think of that marvellous and holy discourse, the more I lose myself in joy.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.77 As memory recalls again and again the exceeding beauty of the Lord, I am filled with amazement and happiness.

author: Shri Purohit Swami
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 18.78 Wherever is the Lord Shri Krishna, the Prince of Wisdom, and wherever is Arjuna, the Great Archer, I am more than convinced that good fortune, victory, happiness and righteousness will follow"

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content:
1.1. Dhrtarastra said O Sanjaya ! What did my men and the sons of Pandu do in the Kuruksetra, the field of righteousness, where the entire warring class has assembled ?
or
O Sanjaya ! What did the selfish intentions and the intentions born of wisdom do in the human body which is the field-of-duties, the repository of the senseorgans and in which all the murderous ones (passions and asceticism etc.) are confronting [each other].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.2. Sanjaya said Seeing the army of the sons of Pandu, marshalled in the military array, the prince Duryodhana approached the teacher (Drona) and spoke at that time, these words:

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.3. O teacher ! Behold this mighty army of the sons of Pandu, marshalled in a military array by Drupada's son, your intelligent pupil.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.4. The heroes and mighty archers, comparable in war to Bhima and Arjuna, here are: Yuyudhana, the king of the Virata country, and Drupada, the mighty warrior;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.5. Dhrstaketu, Cekitana and the valourous king of Kasi, and Kuntibhoja, the coneror of many, and the Sibi king, the best among men;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.6. And Yudhamanyu, the heroic, and Uttamaujas, the valourous, the son of Subhadra and the sons of Draupadiall are indeed mighty warriors.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.7. O best among the twice-born ! However, please also take note of the most distinguished amongst us, who are the generals of my army and who are accepted as leaders by the heroes in the mighty army [of mine]; I shall name them to you.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.8. Your goodself, and Bhisma, and Karna, krpa, Salya, Jayadratha, Asvatthaman, and Vikarna, and Somadatta's son, the valourous;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.9. And many other heroes, giving up their lives for my sake; fighting with various weapons, all very much skilled in different warfares.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.10. Thus the army guarded by Bhima is unlimited (or insufficient) for us; on the other hand, the army guarded by Bhisma is limited (or sufficient) for them (the Pandavas).

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.11. Stationed firmly in all [your] respective paths, every one of you without exception should guard Bhisma, above all.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.12. Generating joy in him, the powerful paternal grandfather (Bhisma), the seniormost among the Kurus, roared highly a lion-roar and blew his conchshell.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.13. Then all on a sudden, the conch-shells, drums, tabors, trumpets, and cow-horns were sounded; that sound was tumultuous.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.14. Then, mounted on mighty chariot, yoked with white horses, Madhava (Krsna) and the son of Pandu (Arjuna) blew their heavenly conch-shells;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.15. Hrsikesa (Krsna) blew the Pancajanya; Dhananjaya (Arjuna) blew the Devadatta; and the Wolf-bellied (Bhimi), of the terrible deeds, blew the mighty conchshell, Paundra;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.16. Kunti's son, the king Yudhisthira blew the Anantavijaya; Nakula and Sahadeva blew [respectively] the Sughosa and the Manipuspaka.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.17. And the king of Kasi, a great archer, and Sikhandin, a mighty warrior; Dhrstadyumna and the king of Virata, and the unconered Satyaki;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.18. The Pancala king, a mighty archer; and Draupad's sons, who are five in number; and the mighty-armed son of Subhadra blew their own conch-shells individually.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.19. Revibrating in both the sky and the earth, the tumultuous sound shattered the hearts of Dhrtarastra's men.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.20. O king! Then observing Dhrtarastra's men, arrayed when the armed clash had [virtually] begun, at that time, Pandu's son, the monkey-bannered one (Arjuna) raising his bow spoke these sentences.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.21. Arjuna said O Acyuta! Please halt my chariot at a centre place between the two armies, so that I may scrutinize these men who are standing with desire to fight and with whom I have to fight in this great war-effort.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.22. I may scrutinize those who are ready to fight, who have assled here and are eager to achieve in the battle, what is dear to the evil-minded son of Dhrtarastra.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.23. - 1.24. Sanjaya said O descendant of Bharata (Dhrtarastra) ! Thus instructed by Gudakesa (Arjuna), Hrsikesa halted the best chariot at a place in between the two armies, in front of Bhisma and Drona and of all the rulers of the earth; and the said: O son of Prtha! Behold these Kurus, assembled.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.23. - 1.24. Sanjaya said O descendant of Bharata (Dhrtarastra) ! Thus instructed by Gudakesa (Arjuna), Hrsikesa halted the best chariot at a place in between the two armies, in front of Bhisma and Drona and of all the rulers of the earth; and the said: O son of Prtha! Behold these Kurus, assembled.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.25. There in both the armies, the son of Prtha observed his fathers, and paternal grandfathers, teachers, maternal uncles, brothers, sons, sons' sons and comrades, fathers-in-law, and also friends.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.26. Noticing all those kinsmen arrayed [in the army], the son of Kunti was overpowered by unmost compassion; and being despondent, he uttered this:

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.27. Arjuna Said O krsna! On seeing these war-mongering kinsfolks of my own, arrayed [in the armies], my limbs fail and my mouth goes dry;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.28. Shivering and horripilation arise in my body; the Gandiva (the bow) slips from my hand and my skin also burns all over.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.29. I am unable even to stand steady; and my mind seems to be confused; and I see adverse omens, O Kesava!

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.30. I also do not foresee any good by killing my own kinsmen in the battle. O Krsna! I wish niether victory, nor kingdom, nor the pleasures [thereof].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.31. O Govinda! Of what use in the kingdom to us? Of what use are the pleasures [thereof] and the life even?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.32. For whose sake we seek kingdom, [its] pleasures and happiness, the very same persons stand arrayed to fight, giving up their life and wealth.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.33. [These are our] teachers, fathers, sons and also paternal grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, son's sons, wives' brothers, and (other) relatives.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.34. O slayer-of-Mandhu (Krsna)! I do not desire to slay these men-even though they slay me-even for the sake of the kingdom of the three worlds-what to speak for the sake of the [mere] earth.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.35. By slaying Dhrtarastra's sons what joy would be to go us, O Janardana?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.36. Nothing but sin would slay these desperadoes and take hold of us. Therefore we should not slay Dhrtarastra's sons, our own relatives.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.37. How could we be happy indeed, O Madhava, after slaying our own kinsmen ?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.38. Of course, these (Dhrtarastra's sons), with their intellect overpowered by greed, do not see the evil conseences ensuing from the ruin of the family and the sin in cheating friends.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.39. But, perceiving clearly the evil conseences ensuing from the ruin of the family, should we not have a sense to refrain from this sinful act [of fighting the war], O Janardana ?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.40. When a family ruins, the etnernal duties of the family perish; when the duties perish, impiety inevitably dominates the entire family.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.41. Because of the domination of impiety, O Krsna, the women of the family become corrupt; when the women become corrupt, O member of the Vrsni-clan, there arises the intermixture of castes;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.42. The intermixture leads the family-ruiners and the family to nothing but the hell; for, their ancestors (their individual souls) fall down [in hell], being deprived of the rites of offering rice-balls and water [intended to them].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.43. On account of these evils of the family-ruiners that cause the intermixture of castes, the eternal caste-duties and family-duties fall into disuse.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.44. O Janardana! Dwelling in the hell is ite certain for men with their family-duties fallen into disuse: this we have heard.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.45. Alas! What a great sinful act have we resolved to undertake ! For, out of greed for the joy of kingdom, we are striving to slay our own kinsfolk !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.46. It would be more beneficial for me if Dhrtarastra's men with weapons in their hands, should slay me, unresisting and unarmed.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 1.47. Sanjaya said Having said this much about the battle, and letting his bow fall with arrows, Arjuna sat down on the back of the chariot, with his mind agitated with grief.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.1. Sanjaya said To him (Arjuna) who was thus possessed by compassion, whose eyes were confused and filled with tears and who was sinking in despondency, Madhusudana told this [following] sentence.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.2. The Bhagavat said O Arjuna ! At a critical moment, whence did this sinful act come to you which is practised by men of ignoble (low) birth and which is leading to the hell and is inglorious ?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.3. Stoop not to unmanliness, O son of Kunti ! It does not befit you. Shirking off the petty weakness of heart, arise, O scorcher of the foes !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.4. Arjuna said How shall I with arrows fight in battle against Bhisma and Drona, both being worthy of reverence ? O slayer of Mandhu, O slayer of foes !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.5. It is good indeed even to go about begging in this world without killing the elders of great dignity; but with greed for wealth, I would not enjoy, by killing my elders, the blood-stained objects of pleasures.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.6. Whether we should coner [in the battle], or they should coner us-we do not know this viz., 'which [of those two] is better for us'. [For], having killed whom, we would not wish to live at all, the same persons stand before us as Dhrtarastra's men.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.7. With my very nature, overpowered by the taint of pity, and with my mind, utterly confused as to the right action [at the present juncture], I ask you: Tell me definitely what would be good [to me]; I am your pupil; please teach me, who am taking refuge in You.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.8. I do not clearly see what would drive out my grief, the scorcher of my sense-organs, even after achieving, a prosperous and unrivalled kingship in this earth and also the overlordship of the gods [in the heaven].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.9. Sanjaya said O scorcher of foes (O Dhrtarastra) ! Having spoken to Hrsikesa (the master of sense-organs), Govinda (Krsna) in this manner, and having declared 'I will not fight', Gudakesa (Arjuna), became silent !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.10. O descendant of Bharata (O Dhrtarastra) ! Hrsikesa, as if [he was] smiling, spoke to him who was sinking in despondency in between two armies.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.11. While lamenting for those who cannot be lamented on and those who do not reire to be lamented on, you do not talk like a wise man ! The learned do not lament for those of departed life and those of non-departed life.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.12. Never indeed at any time [in the past] did I not exist, nor you, nor these kings; and never shall we all not exist hereafter.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.13. Just as the boyhood, youth and old age come to the embodied Soul in this body, in the same manner is the attaining of another body; the wise man is not deluded at that.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.14. O son of Kunti ! But the touches with the matras cause the [feelings of] cold and heat, pleasure and pain; they are of the nature of coming and going and are transient. Forbear them, O Descendent of Bharata !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.15. O the best among persons ! That wise person becomes immortal whom these (situations) do not trouble and to whom the pleasure and pain are eal.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.16. Birth (or existence) does not happen to what is non-existent, and destruction (or non-existence) to what is existent; the finality of these two has been seen by the seers of the reality.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.17. And know That to be destructionsless, by Which all this (universe) is pervaded; no one is capable of causing destruction to this changeless One.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.18. These physical bodies that have an end and suffer the peculiar destruction, are declared to belong to the eternal embodied Soul, Which is destructionless and imcomprehensible. Therefore fight, O descendent of Bharata !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.19. Whosoever views This to be the slayer and whosoever believes This to be the slain, both these do not understand : This does not slay, nor is This slain.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.20. This is neither born; nor ever dies; nor, having not been at one time, will This come to be again. This is unborn, destructionless, eternal and ancient and is not slain [even] when the body is slain.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.21. Whosever realises This to be changeless, destructionless, unborn and immutable, how can that person be slain; how can he either slay [any one] ? O son of Prtha !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.22. Just as rejecting the tattered garments, a man takes other new ones, in the same way, rejecting the decayed bodies, the embodied (Self) rightly proceeds to other new ones.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.23. Weapons do not cut This; fire does not burn This; water does not (make) This wet; and the wind does not make This dry.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.24. This is not to be cut; This is not to be burnt; (This is) not to be made wet and not to be dried too; This is eternal, all-pervading, stable, immobile and eternal.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.25. This is declared to be non-evident, imponderable, and unchangeable. Therefore understanding This as such you should not lament.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.26. On the other hand, if you deem This as being born constantly or as dying constantly, even then, O mighty-armed one, you should not lament This.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.27. Death is certain indeed for what is born; and birth is certain for what is dead. Therefore you should not lament over a thing that is unavoidable.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.28. O descendant of Bharata ! The beings have an unmanifest beginning, manifest middle and certainly the unmanifest end. On that account why mourning?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.29. This someone observes as a wonder; similarly another speaks of This as a wonder; another hears This as a wonder; but even after hearing, not even one understands This.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.30. O descendant of Bharata ! This embodied One in the body of every one is for ever incapable of being slain. Therefore you should not lament over all beings.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.31. Further, considering your own duty, you should not waver. Indeed, for a Ksatriya there exists no duty superior to fighting a righteous war.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.32. O son of Prtha ! By good fortune, Ksatriyas, desirous of happiness, get a war of this type [to fight], which has come on its own accord and which is an open door to the heaven.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.33. On the other hand, if you will not fight this righteous war then you shall incur the sin by avoiding your own duty and fame.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.34. The creatures will speak of your endless ill-fame; and for the one who has been highly esteemed the illfame is worse than death.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.35. The mighty charioteers will think of you as having withdrawn from the battle out of fear : having been highly regarded by these men, you shall be viewed lightly.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.36. Slandering your ability, the enemies will talk of you many sayings that should not be talked of. Is there anything more painful than that ?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.37. If you are slain you shall attain heaven; or if you coner, you shall enjoy the earth. Therefore, O son of Kunti ! stand up with resolution made in favour of [fighting] the battle.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.38. Viewing alike, pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat, you should get then ready for the battle. Thus you will not incur sin.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.39. Listen, how this knowledge, imparted [to you] for your sankhya, is [also] for the Yoga; endowed with which knowledge you shall cast off the bondage of action, O son of Prtha !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.40. Here there is no loss due to transgression, and there exists no contrary downward course (sin); even a little of this righteous thing saves [one] from great danger.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.41. O source of joy to the Kurus ! The knowledge in the form of determination is just one; [but] the knowledge (thoughts) of those who do not have determination, has many branches and has no end.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.42. - 2.43. O son of Prtha ! Those, whose very nature is desire, whose goal is heaven, who esteem only the Vedic declaration [of fruits], who declare that there is nothing else, who proclaim this flowery speech about the paths to the lordship of the objects of enjoyment-[the paths] that are full of different actionsand who desire action alone as a fruit of their birth-they are men without insight.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.42. - 2.43. O son of Prtha ! Those, whose very nature is desire, whose goal is heaven, who esteem only the Vedic declaration [of fruits], who declare that there is nothing else, who proclaim this flowery speech about the paths to the lordship of the objects of enjoyment-[the paths] that are full of different actionsand who desire action alone as a fruit of their birth-they are men without insight.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.44. Those, who are very much attached to the ownership of enjoyable objects and whose minds have been carried away by that (flowery speech)-their knowledge, in the form of determination is not prescribed for concentration.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.45. The Vedas bind by means of the three Strands. [Hence] O Arjuna, you must be free from the three Strands, free from the pairs [of opposites]; be established in this eternal Being; be free from [the idea of] acisition and preservation; and be possessed of the Self.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.46. What portion in a reservoir, flooded with water everywhere, is useful [for a man in thirst], that much portion [alone] in all the Vedas is useful for an intelligent student of the Vedas.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.47. Let your claim lie on action alone and never on the fruits; you should never be a cause for the fruits of action; let not your attachment be to inaction.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.48. O Dhananjaya ! Established in the Yoga, perform actions, abandoning attachment, remaining even-minded in success and failure; for, the even-mindedness is said to be the Yoga.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.49. O Dhananjaya ! The inferior action stays away at a distance due to Yoga of (one's contact with) determining faculty; in the determining faculty you must seek refuge; wretched are those who constitute the causes for the fruits of action.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.50. Whosoever is endowed with determining faculty-he casts off both of these viz., the good action and the bad action. Therefore strive for Yoga; Yoga is proficiency is action.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.51. By renouncing the fruit, born of action, the intelligent ones endowed with determining faculty and freed from the bond of birth, go to the place that is devoid of illness.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 2.52. When your determining faculty goes beyond the impregnable thicket of delusion, at that time you will attain an attitude of futility regarding what has to be heard and what has been heard.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
