alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.21. Having enjoyed that vast world of heaven, they, when their merit is exhausted, enter the world of the mortals. Thus the persons, who long for pleasure and continuously take refuge in the code of conduct prescribed by the Three Vedas, attain the state of going and coming.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.22. Those men who, having nothing else [as their goal] worship Me everywhere and are thinking of Me [alone]; to them, who are constantly and fully attached [to Me], I bear acisition and the security of acisition.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.23. O son of Kunti ! Even those who are the devotees of other gods and worship [them] with faith, worship Me alone, [but] following non-injunction;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.24. Because, I am the enjoyer as well as the lord of all sacrifices. But they do not recognise Me correctly and hence they move away [from Me].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.25. The votaries of the gods attain the gods; the votaries of the manes attain the manes; performers of sacrifices for the goblins attain the goblins; also the performers of scrifices for Me attain Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.26. Whosoever with devotion offers Me a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or [a little] water, I taste that offered with devotion by one with well-controlled self (mind).

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.27. Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever oblation you offer, whatever gift you make and what-ever austerity you perform, O son of Kunti, do that as an offering to Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.28. Thus, you shall be freed from the good and evi results which are the action-bonds. Having your innate nature immersed in the Yoga of renunciation and (thus) being fully liberated you shall attain Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.29. I am the same in all beings; to Me none is hateful and none is dear; but whosoever worship Me with devotion, they are in Me and I am in them.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.30. Even if an incorrigible evil-doer worships Me, not resorting to anything else [as his goal], he should be deemed to be righteous; for, he has undertaken his task properly.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.31. Quickly he becomes righteous-souled (minded) and attains peace permanently. O son of Kunti ! I swear that my devotee gets never lost.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.32. O son of Prtha, even those who are of sinful birth, [besides] women, men of working class, and the members of the fourth caste-even they, having taken refuge in Me, attain the highest goal.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.33. Certainly it should be so in the case of the pious men of the priestly class and of the devoted royal seers. Having come to (i.e., being born in) this transient and joyless world, you should be devoted to Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.34. Have your mind fixed on Me; be My devotee; offer scrifice to Me; [and] pay homage to Me; thus fixing your self (internal organ) and having Me as your supreme goal, you shall certainly attain Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.1. The Bhagavat said O mighty-armed [Arjuna] ! Yet, again listen to My best message, which, with good intention, I shall declare to you, who are dear to Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.2. Neither the hosts of gods, nor the great seers know My origin. For, I am the first, in every respect, among the gods and great seers.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.3. Whosoever knows Me as the unborn and beginningless Absolute Lord of the universe, that person, not deluded among the mortals, is delivered from all sins.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.4. Intellect, knowledge, steadiness, patience, truth, control [over sense-organs], tranility [of mind], pleasure, pain, birth, death, fear and courage;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.5. [Also] non-injury, eanimity, contentment, austerity, charity, repute and ill-repute - all these diverse dispositions of beings emanate from none but Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.6. The ancient Seven Great-Seers and also the Four Manus, of whom these creatures in this world are offsprings-they have been born as My mental dispositions.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.7. He, who knows correctly this extensively manifesting power and the Yogic power of Mine-he is endowed with the unwavering Yoga. There is no doubt about it.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.8. 'He is the source of all and from Him all comes forth' - Thus viewing, the wise men revere Me with devotion.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.9. Having their mind fixed on Me, their life gone into Me, enlightening each other, and constantly talking of Me, they are pleased and are delighted.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.10. To these persons, who are [thus] mingling [with Me] and revere [Me] with love, I grant that knowledge-Yoga by means of which they reach Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.11. Out of compassion only towards these men, I, who remain as their very Self, destroy with teh shining light of wisdom, their darkness born of ignorance,

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.12. - 10.13. Arjuna said You are the Supreme Brahman, Supreme Abode, Supreme Purifier. All the seers and also the divine seer Narada, Asita Devala, Vyasa describe You as the Eternal Divine Soul, the unborn, all-manifesting First-God. You too say so to me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.12. - 10.13. Arjuna said You are the Supreme Brahman, Supreme Abode, Supreme Purifier. All the seers and also the divine seer Narada, Asita Devala, Vyasa describe You as the Eternal Divine Soul, the unborn, all-manifesting First-God. You too say so to me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.14. What You tell me, I take all to be true, O Kesava ! For, O Bhagavat, neither the gods nor the great seers know Your manifestation.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Dr.S.Sankaranarayan did not comment on this sloka

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.16. You are [alone] capable of fully declaring the auspicious manifesting powers of Yours, by which manifesting power You remain pervading these worlds.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.17. O Mighty Yogin ! How should I know You, meditating on You ? In what several entities, O Bhagavat, are You to be contemplated upon by me ?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.18. In detail, please expound, once again Your own Yogic power and the manifesting power. O Janardana ! I don't feel contended in hearing Your nectar-[like exposition].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.19. The Bhagavat said Yes. O the best among the Kurus ! I shall expound to you, only the chief auspicious manifesting powers of Mine. For, there would be no end to My details.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.20. O coneror of sleep ! I am the Soul residing in the heart of all beings; I am the beginning, and the middle and also the very end of beings.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.21. Of the sons of Aditi, I am Visnu; of the luminaries, the radiant Sun; of the Maruts, I am Marici; of the stars, I am the Moon.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.22. Of the Vedas, I am the Samaveda; of the gods, I am Vasava (Indra); of the sense-organs, I am the mind; of the beings, I am the sentience.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.23. And of the Rudras, I am Sankara; of the Yaksas and the Raksas, [I am] the Lord-of-Wealth (Kubera); of the Vasus, I am the Fire-god; of the mountains, I am the Meru.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.24. Of the royal priests I am the chief viz., Brhaspati (the priest of gods), O son of Prtha, you should know that; of the army-generals, I am Skanda [the War-god]; of the water reservoirs, I am the ocean.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.25. Of the great seers, I am Bhrgu; of the words, I am the Single-syllable (Om); of the sacrifices [performed with external objects], I am the sacrifice of muttering prayer; of the immovables, I am the Himalayan range.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.26. Of all trees, I am the Pipal-tree; and of the divine seers, Narada; of the Gandharvas (the celestial musicians), Citraratha; of the perfected ones, the sage Kapila.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.27. Of the horses, you should know Me to be the nectar-born Uccaihsravas (Indra's horse); of the best elephants, the Airavata (Indra's elephant); and of the men, their king.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.28. Of the weapons, I am the Vajra [of Indra]; of the cows, I am the Wish-fullfilling Cow [of the heaven]; of the progenitors, I am Kandarpa (the god-of-love); of the serpents, I am Vasuki.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.29. Of the snakes, I am Ananta; of the water-beings (water-deities), I am varuna; of the manes, I am Aryaman; of the controllers, I am Yama (the Death-god).

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.30. No such translation is available for this sloka.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.31. Of the progenies of Diti (the demons), I am Prahlada; of the measuring ones, I am the shark; of rivers, I am the daughter of Jahnu (the Ganga).

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.32. Of the creations, I am the beginning, the end and also the middle, O Arjuna ! Of the sciences, [I am] the science of the Self; of arguers, I am the argument.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.33. Of the syllables, I am A; of the compounds, the Dvandva; none but Me, is the immortal Time; I am the dispenser [of fruits actions] facing on all sides.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.34. I am the Death that carries away all and also the Birth of all that are to be born; of the wives of men, I am the Fame, Fortune, Speech, Memory, Wisdom, Constancy and Patience.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.35. Likewise, of the modes of singing [of the hymns], I am the Brhatsaman; of the metres, I am the Gayatri; of the months, I am the Margasirsa; of the seasons, I am the season abounding with flowers.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.36. I am gambling of the fradulent; I am the brilliance of the brilliant; I am the victory; I am the resolution; I am the energy of the energetic.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.37. Of the Vrsnis (the members of the Vrsni clan), I am the son of Vasudeva; of the sons of Pandu, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) [I am]; of the sages too, I am Vyasa; of the seers, the seer Usanas.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.38. I am the punishment [at the hands] of the punishers; I am the political wisdom of those who seek victory; I am also silence of the secret ones; I am the knowledge of the knowers.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.39. Further, O Arjuna, I am that which is the seed of all beings; there is no being, whether moving or non-moving, that could exist without Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.40. O scorcher of foes ! There is no end to My extraordinary manifesting Power. The above details of [My] manifesting power have been declared by Me only by way of examples.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.41. Whatsoever being exists with the manifesting power, and with beauty and vigour, be sure that it is born only of a bit of My illuminant.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.42. Or, O Arjuna ! Why this detailed statement ? I remain, pervading this entire universe with a single fraction [of Myself].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.1. Arjuna said My delusion has completely gone thanks to the great and mysterious discourse which is termed as a science governing the Soul and which You have delivered by way of favouring me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.2. The origin and the dissolution of beings have been listened to in detail by me from You, O Lotus-eyed One, and also to [Your] inexhaustible greatness.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.3. As You describe Yourself as the Supreme Lord [of all], it must be so. [Hence], O Supreme Self, I desire to perceive Your Lordly form.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.4. O Master ! If you think that it is possible for me to see that form, then, O Lord of the Yogins, please show me Your Immortal Self.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.5. The Bhagavat said Behold, O son of Prtha, My divine forms in hundreds and in thousands and of varied nature and of varied colours and varied shapes.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.6. Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the twin Asvins, and the Maruts; O son of Pandu, behold also many wonders that had never been seen before.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.7. Now, behold the entire universe, including the moving and the unmoving, and whatsoever else you desire to see-all established in one here, in My body, O Gudakesa (Arjuna) !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.8. But, you cannot see Me simply with this eye of yours [Hence], I give you the divine eye. [Now] behold the Lordly form of Mine.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.9. Sanjaya said O king ! Having thus stated, Hari (Krsna), the mighty Lord of the Yogins, showed to the son of Prtha [His own] Supreme Lordly form;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.10. That has many mouths and eyes, many wondrous sights, many heavenly ornaments, and many heavenly weapons held ready;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.11. That wears heavenly garlands and garments; has the unguent of heavenly sandal paste; it is all wonderful, shining (or godly), infinite; and it has faces in all directions.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.12. If the splendour of a thousand suns were to burst forth at once in the sky, would that be eal to the splendour of that Mighty Self ?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.13. At that time the son of Pandu beheld there in the body of the God-of-gods, the entire universe, united in one and [yet] divided into many groups.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.14. Then, possessed by amazement and with his bodily hair thrilled, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) with his head bowed to the God and with folded palms spoke [to Him].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.15. Arjuna said O God ! In Your body I behold all gods and also hosts of different kinds of beings-the Lord Brahma seated on the lotus-seat; and all the seers and all the glowing serpents.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.16. I behold You of many arms, bellies, mouths and eyes and of infinite forms on all sides; of You, I find neither the end, nor the centre, nor the beginnng too, O Lord of the universe, O Universal-formed One !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.17. I behold You as having crowns, clubs and discs; as a mass of radiance, shining on all sides, hard to look at and on each side blazing like burning fire and the sun; and as an immeasurable one.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.18. You are the imperishable, the Supreme Being to be known; You are the ultimate place of rest for this universe; You are changeless and the guardian of the pious act of the Satvatas; You are the everlasting Soul, I believe.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.19. I observe You having to beginning, no middle and no end; having infinite creative power, and infinite arms; as havig the moon and the sun for Your eyes, and the blazing fire for Your mouth; [and] as acorching this universe with Your rediance.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.20. This space in between the heaven and the earth as well as all the directions are pervaded singly by You; seeing this wondrous form of Yours as such, O Exalted Soul, the triple world is very much frightened.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.21. These hosts of gods enter into You; some frightened ones recite [hymns] with folded palms; simply crying 'Hail !', the hosts of great seers praise You with the excellent praising hymns.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.22. The Rudras, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Sadhyas, the Visvas (Visvadevas), the twin Asvins and the Maruts, and the Steam-drinkers (Manes) and the hosts of the Gandharvas, the Yoksas, the demons and the perfected ones - all gaze on You and are ite amazed.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.23. O Mighty-armed One ! Having seen Your mighty form that has many faces and eyes, many arms, thighs and feet, and many bellies, and is terrible with many tusks; the worlds are frightened and so also myself.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.24. As I observe You [with form] touching the sky; blazing; having many colours, mouths wide open, eyes blazing and large; I am terrified in my inner soul (mind); and I do not get courage and peace, O Visnu !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.25. By merely seeing Your faces that are frightening with tusks and are looking like the fire of destruction, I do not know the arters and get no peace. Have mercy, O Lord of gods ! O Abode of the Universe !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.26. All these sons of Dhrtarastra along with the entire hosts of kings, this Bhisma, this Drona and this son of the charioteer (Karna), together with the chief warriors of ours too;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.27. They enter, hastening, into Your terrible mouths, frightening with tusks; some [of them], sticking in between Your teeth, are clearly visible with their heads powered.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.28. Just as many water-rapids of the rivers race heading towards the ocean alone, in the same manner these heroes of the world of men do enter into Your mouths flaming all around.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.29. Just as with full speed, the moths enter into the flaming fire for their own destruction, in the same manner the worlds also do enter, for their own destruction with full speed, into the mouths of Yours.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.30. Devouring, on all sides with Your blazing mouths, the entire worlds, You are licking up; Your terrible rays scroch the entire universe filling it with their radiance, O Visnu !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.31. Please, tell me who You are with a terrible form; O the Best of gods ! Salutation to You, please be merciful. I am desirious of knowing You, the Primal One in detail; for I do not clearly comprehend Your behaviour.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.32. The Bhagavat said I am the Time, the world-destroyer, engaged here in withdrawing the worlds that are overgrown; even without you (your fighting) all the warriors, standing in the rival armies, would cease to be.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.33. Therefore, stand up, win glory, and vanishing foes, enjoy the rich kingdom; these [foes] have already been killed by Myself; [hence] be a mere token cause [in their destruction], O ambidextrous archer !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.34. Slay Drona and Bhisma, and Jayadratha, and Karna as well as the other heroes of the world-all already slain by Me. Do not get distressed; fight; you shall vanish enemies in the battle.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.35. Sanjaya said On hearing this speach of Kesava, the crowned-prince (Arjuna) had his palms folded; and trembling he protstrated himself to Krsna; and stammering, and being very much afraid and bowing down, he spoke to Him again.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.36. Arjuna said O Lord of sense-organs (Krsna) ! It is appropriate that the universe rejoices and feels exceedingly delighted by the high glory of yours; that in fear the demons fly on all directions; and that the hosts of the perfected ones bow down [to You].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.37. O Mighty One ! Why should they not bow down to You, the Primal Creater, Who are greater than even Brahma (personal god) ? O Endless One, O Lord of gods, O Abode of the universe ! You are unalterable, existent, non-existent and also that which is beyond both.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.38. You are the Primal God; You are the Ancient Soul; You are the transcending place of rest for this universe; You are the knower and the knowable; You are the Highest Abode; and the universe with its infinite forms is pervaded by You.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.39. You are Vayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, the Moon, Prajapati and the Great-paternal-grand-father; Salutation and salutation thousand times to You; and again also more salutation and salutation to You.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.40. Salutation to You in the front and behind; salutation to You, just on all sides, O One Who are All ! You are of infinite might and of immeasurable powers; and You pervade all and hence You are all.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.41. Taking You for a [mere] companion, not knowing this greatness of Yours, and out of my carelessness or through even affection, whatever I have importunately called You as O Krsna, O Yadava, O Comrade; and,

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.42. Whatever disrespect was shown by me to You, to make fun of You in the course of play, or while on the bed, or on the seat, or at meals, either alone, or in the presence of repectable persons - for that I beg pardon of You, the Unconceivable One, O Acyuta !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.43. You are the father of the world of the moving and unmoving; You are the great preceptor of this universe; in the triad of worlds there is no one eal to You-How can there be anyone else superior ? - having greatness not comprehended.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.44. Hence, paying homage, and prostrating may body, I solicit grace of You, the Lord praisworthy. O God ! Be pleased to bear with me, just as a beloved father with his beloved son and just as a dear friend with his dear friend.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.45. I am thrilled by seeing what has not been seen earlier; and my mind is very much distressed with fear; show me the same (usual) form of Yours; kindly be appeased O God ! Lord of gods ! O Abode of the worlds !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.46. I desire to see You in the same manner, wearing crown, holding the club and the discuss in hand; please be with the same form having four hands, O Thousand-armed One ! O Universal Form !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.47. The Bhagavat said Being gracious towards you, I have shown you, O Arjuna, this supreme form, as a result of [Your] concentration on the Self; this form of Mine full of splendour universal , unending and primal, has been never seen before by anybody other than your-self.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.48. Not by the knowledge of the Vedas and sacrifices, nor by making gifts, nor by the rituals, nor by severe austerities, can I be seen in this form in the world of men, by anybody other than yourself, O the great hero of the Kurus !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.49. Let there be no distress and no bewilderment in you by seeing this terrific and violent form of Mine; being free from fear, cheerful at heart, behold again this form of Mine which is the same [as before].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.50. Having said to Arjuna as above, Vasudeva revealed His own tiny form; assuming His gentle body once again, the Mighty Soul (Krsna) consoled the frightened Arjuna.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.51. Arjuna said On seeing this gentle human form of Yours, O Janardana, now I have regained my nature and have now collected my thinking faculty.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.52. The Bhagavat said This form of Mine, which you have just observed is extremely difficult to observe; even gods are always curious of observing this form.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.53. Neither by reciting Vedas, no by obseving austerity, nor by offering gifts, nor by performing sacrifice, can I be observed in this manner as you have see Me now.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.54. But, through an undeviating devotion, it is possible to know, and to observe and also to enter into Me as such, O Arjuna ! O scorcher of foes !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.55. He, who performs actions for [attaining] Me; who regards Me as his supreme goal; who is devoted to Me; who is free from attachment; and who is free from hatred towards all beings-he attains me, O son of Pandu !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.1. Arjuna said Those devotees who, being constantly attached [to You], worship You thus; and also those who [worship] the motionless Unmanifest-of these who who are the best knowers of Yoga ?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.2. The Bhagavat said Those, who, causing their mind to enter well into Me, and being permanently attached [to Me], and endowed with an extraordinary faith, worship Me - they are considered by Me to be the best among the masters of Yoga.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Dr.S.Sankaranarayan did not comment on this sloka

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.4. Who, by restraining properly the group of sense-organs have eanimity at all stages, and find pleasure in the welfare of all beings - they attain nothing but Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.5. (But) the trouble is much more for them, who have their mind fixed on the Unmanifest; for the Unmanifest-goal is attained with difficulty by men, bearing body.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.6. On the other hand, those who, having renounced all their actions in Me, have Me [alone] their goal; and revere Me, meditating on Me by that Yoga alone, which admits no other element but Me in it;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.7. Of them, having their mind completely entered in Me, I become, before long, a redeemer from the ocean of the death-cycle, O son of Prtha !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.8. [Hence], fix your mind on nothing but Me; cuase your taught to settle in Me. Thus resorting to the best Yoga, you will dwell in Me alone.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.9. In case you are not able to cause your mind to enter completley into Me, then, O Dhananjaya ! seek to attain Me by the practice-Yoga.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.10. If you are incapable of doing a [steady] practice, then have, your chief aim, of performing actions for Me. Even by performing actions for Me, You shall attain success.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.11. Now, if you are not capable of doing this too, then taking resort to My Yoga renounce the fruit of all action, with your self (mind) subdued.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.12. For, knowledge is superior to practice; because of knowledge, meditation becomes pre-eminent; from meditation issues the renunciation of fruits of actions; and to renunciation, peace remains next.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.13. He, who is not a hater, [but] only a compassionate friend of every being; who is free from the sense of 'mine, and the sense of 'I'; who is even minded in pain and pleasure and is endowed with forbearance;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.14. Who remains well-content and is a man of Yoga at all times; who is self-controlled and is firmly resolute; and who has offered to Me his mind and intellect-that devotee of Mine is dear to Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.15. He, on account of whom the world does not get agitated; who too does not feel agitated on account of the world; who is free from joy and impatience, fear and anxiety-he is dear to Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.16. He, who does not expect [anything]; who is pure, dexterous, unconcerned, untroubled; and who has renonced all his undertakings all around-that devotee of Mine is dear to Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.17. He, who neither delights no hates, nor grieves, nor craves; who has renounced both the good and the bad results [of actions] and is full of devotion [to Me]-he is dear to Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Dr.S.Sankaranarayan did not comment on this sloka

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.19. To whom blame and praise are eal; who is silent (does not over-speak) and is well content with one thing or other [that comes to him]; who has no fixed thought [in the mundane life]; who is [yet] steady-minded [in spiritual practice] and is full of devotion-that man is dear to Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.20. Those, who resort, as instructed above, to this duty [conducive to] immortality, who have faith [in it] and have Me alone their goal - those devotees are exceedingly dear to Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.2. The Bhagavat said O son of Kunti ! This [physical] hody is called 'Field' [and decayer-cum-protector]; He, who sensitiezes it - His knowers call Him properly as 'Field-sensitizer'.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.3. O descendant of Bharata ! You should know Me to be also the Field-sensitizer in the Fields of all. The knowledge of the Field and the Field-sensitizer-that knowledge is [in fact] the understanding of Me.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.4. What that Field is and of what nature it is; why it modifies, whence and what; and who he (the Field-sensitizer) is; and of what nature He is; listen to [all] that from Me collectively.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.5. This has been sung many times by sages, and also has been clearly decided in the various Vedas in different contexts by means of [their] words that are suggestive of the Brahman (i.e. in the Upanisads) and are full of reasoning.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.6. The [five] great elements, the Egotism. The Intellect, the Unmanifest, and also the ten organs and the one (organ and the) five objects of the sense-organs;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.7. The desire, the hatred. the pleasure, the pain, the aggregate, the sensibility and the feeling of satisfaction (or self-?nd) : This, together with modification, is what is collectively called 'the Field, together with modification'.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.8. Absence of pride; absence of hypocricy; harm-lessness; patience; uprightness; service to the preceptor; purity [of mind and body]; steadfastness; self-control;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.9. Absence of desire for sense-objects; and also absence of egotism; pondering over the evils of birth, death, old age, sickness and sorrow;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.10. Non-attachment; detachment towards [one's] children, wives, houses and the like; and a constant eal-mindedness on the occurrence of the desirable and the undesirable things;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.11. And an unfailing devotion towards Me, with the Yoga of non-difference; resorting to solitary place; distaste for a crowd of people;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.12. Constancy in the Self-knowledge; and viewing things of knowing the Reality-all this is declared to be [conducive to or manifesting] true knowledge, and what is opposed to this is [conducive to or manifesting] wrong knowledge.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.13. I shall describe that which is to be known, by knowing which one attains freedom from death : beginningless is the Supreme Brahman; It is said to be neither existent nor non-existent.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.14. It has hands and feet of all, has eyes, heads and faces of all, has ears of all in the world; It remains enveloping all.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.15. It causes all the sense-alities to shine; [yet] It is without any sense-organ; It is unattached, yet all-supporting; It is free from the Strands, yet enjoys the Strands.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.16. It is without and within every being and is unmoving and yet moving too; due to Its subtle nature It is incomprehensible; It exists far away, yet near It is.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.17. It remains undistinguished (common) in the distinguished [beings], and appears as if distinguished. It is to be known as the supporter of beings, and also as [their] swallower and orginator.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.18. This is the Light even of [all] the lights, [and] is stated to be beyond darkness; It is to be known by [the above] knowledge; It is to be attained [only] by knowledge; and It distinctly remains in the heart of all.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.19. This field as well as the knowledge and what is to be known, all are mentioned collectively; clearly understanding this, My devotee becomes worthy of My state.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.20. Both the Material Cause and the Soul too are beginningless, you should know this; you should also know that the modifications and Strands are born of the Material Cause.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.21. In creating [the process of] cause-and-effect, the Material Cause is said to be the basis; and in experiencing pleasure and pain, the Soul is said to be the basis.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.22. For, the Soul, seated on the Material Cause, enjoys the Strands born of the Material Cause; His attachment to the Strands is the cause for his births in the good and evil wombs.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.23. The Supreme Soul in this [corporeal] body is called the Spectator, the Assentor, the Supporter, the Experiencer, the Mighty Lord and also the Supreme Self.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.24. He who knows, in this manner, the Soul and the Material Cause together with Strands-he is not born again, even though he behaves in different ways.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.25. [However] by means of meditation, certain persons (Yogis) perceive the Self as the Self in the self (the heart etc.); others by the knowledge-Yoga; and others by the action-Yoga.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.26. But others, who have no knowledge of this nature, listen from others and practise reflection [accordingly] they too, being devoted to what they have heard, do cross over death.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.27. Whatever living being is born, stationary or moving, you should know that all this has a close connection with the Field and the Field-sensitizer, O the best of the Bharatas !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.28. Whosoever perceives the Supreme Lord as abiding and as non-perishing in all beings alike, while they perish - he perceives properly.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.29. Whosoever, perceiving the Lord as abiding in all alike, does not harm the Self by the Self-he attains, on that account, the Supreme Goal.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.30. Whosoever views all actions as being performed (or all objects as being created), indeed by the Material Cause itself and at the same time views his own Self as non-performer (or non-creator) - he veiws properly.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.31. When he perceives the [mutual] difference of beings as abiding in One, and its expansion from That alone, at that time he becomes the Brahman.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.32. Because This is beginningless, and because This has no alities, this Supreme Self is changeless and It neither acts, nor gets stained [by actions], even-though It dwells in the body, O son of Kunti !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.33. Just as the all-pervading Ether is not stained because of its subtleness, in the same fashion the Self, abiding in the body everywhere, is not stained.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.34. Just as a single sun illumines this entire world, so also the Lord-of-the-Field illumines the entire Field, O descendant of Bharata !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.35. Those who thus understand, with the knowledge-eye, the inner Soul of the Field and the Field-sensitizer and also the deliverance from the Material Cause of the elements-they attain the Supreme.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.1. The Bhagavat said Further, once again I shall explain the supreme knowledge, the best among the knowledges, by knowing which all the seers have gone from here to the Supreme Success.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.2. Holding on to this knowledge, they have attained the state of having attributes common with Me; [and] they are neither born even at the time of creation [of the world], nor do they come to grief at the time of dissolution [of it].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.3. The mighty Brahman is a womb for Me; and in That I lay seed; therefrom is the birth of all beings, O descendant of Bharata !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.4. O son of Kunti ! Whatever manifestations spring up in all the wombs, of them the mighty Brahman is the womb and I am the father laying the seed.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.5. The Strands, viz. the Sattva, the Rajas and the Tamas, born from the Prime Cause (the said Mother), bind the changeless Embodied (Soul) to the body, O mighty-armed One !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.6. Among them (the Strands) the Sattva-because it is dirtless-is illuminating and healthy; and it binds [the Embodied] by attachment to happiness and also by attachment to knowledge, O sinless one !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.7. You should know that the Rajas is of the nature of desire and is a source of craving-attachment; and it binds the embodied by the attachment to action, O son of Kunti !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.8. But, you should [also] know that the Tamas is born of ignorance and is a deluder of all the Embodied; it binds [them] by negligence, laziness and sleep, O descendant of Bharata !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.9. O descendant of Bharata ! The Sattva fully dominates [the Embodied] in the field of happiness; the Rajas in action; but the Tamas also totally dominates in the field of negligence, by veiling knowledge.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.10. O descendant of Bharata ! The Sattva increases by overpowering the Rajas and the Tamas; the Rajas [increases by overpowering] the Sattva and the Tamas; and the Tamas does likewise [by overpowering] the Sattva and the Rajas.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.11. When the knowledge-light arises in all the gates in this body, then one should also know that the Sattva has increased predominantly.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.12. Greed, exertion, undertaking of actions, unrest, and craving-these are born when the Rajas increases predominantly, O chief of the Bharatas !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.13. Absence of [mental] illumination, non-excertion, negligence and mere delusion-these are born when the Tamas is on the increase predominantly, O darling of the Kurus !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.14. But, if the body-bearer dies at the time when Sattva is on the increase, then he attains to the spotless worlds of those, who know the Highest.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.15. By meeting death when the Rajas [is on the increase], he is born among those who are attached to action; likewise meeting death when the Tamas [is on the increase], he is born in the wombs of the duluded.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.16. The fruit of good action, they say, is spotless and is of the Sattva; but the fruit of the Rajas is pain, and the fruit of the Tamas is ignorance.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.17. From the Sattva arises wisdom; from the Rajas only greed; and from the Tamas arise negligence, delusion and also ignorance.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.18. Those who are established in the Sattva, go upward; the persons given to the Rajas, remain in the middle [state]; those who are given to the Tamas, being established in the tendencies of bad alities, go downwards.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.19. When the Perceiver (the Self) finds no agent other than the Strands, and realises That which is beyond the Strands, then he attains My state.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.20. Transcending these three Strands, of which the body [etc.] is born, the Embodied (the Soul), being freed from birth, death, old age and sorrow, attains immortality.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.21. Arjuna said O Master ! with what characteristic marks does he, who has transcended these three Strands, exist ? Of what behaviour is he ? And, how does he pass beyond these three Strands ?

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.22. The Bhagavat said O son of Pandu ! He does niether abhor nor crave for illumination, and exertion, and delusion too, as and when they arise or cease to be.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.23. He who, sitting like an unconcerned person, is not perturbed by the Strands; who is ignorant that the Strands exist; (or who remain simply aware that the Strands [alone] exist) who is not shaken;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.24. To whom pain, pleasure and sleep are alike; to whom a cold, a stone and a lump of gold are alike; to whom both the pleasant and the unpleasant things are eal; who is firm [in mind]; to whom blame and personal commendation are eal;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.25. Who remains eal to honour and to dishonour, and eal to the sides of [both] the friend and the foe; and who has given up all fruits of his initiatives-he is said to have transcended the Strands.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.26. Whosoever serves Me alone with an unfailing devotion-Yoga, he, transcending these Strands, turns to be the Brahman.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.27. 'I' is the place of support for the immortal and changeless Brahman and for [Its] eternal attribute, the unalloyed Happiness.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.1. The Bhagavat said [The scriptures] speak of a non-perishing holy Fig-tree, which has root that is high (or above) and branches that are low (or below) and of which the [Vedic] hymns are leaves-he who knows this (Tree) is the knower of the Vedas;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.2. Of which (Tree) the branches, spreading downward and upward, well developed with Strands, have sense objects as sprouts; also below in the human world are Its roots, stretching successively, having actions for their sub-knots.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.3. The nature of this is not perceived in that manner, nor its end, nor its beginning and nor its centre (the middle). Cutting this holy Fig-tree-with its firmly and variedly grown roots-by means of the sharp (or strong) exe of non-attachment;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.4. Then that Abode must be sought, having reached Which one would not return. [The Yogin] would attain nothing but that Primal Person from Whom the old activity (world creation) commences.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.5. Those who are rid of pride and delusion; have put down the evils of attachment; remain constantly in their own nature of the Self; have their desires completely departed; and are fully liberated from the pairs known as pleasures and pains-these undeluded men go to that changeless Abode.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.6. The sun does not illumine That; nor the moon and nor the fire; That is My Abode Supreme, having gone to Which they (Yogins) never return.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.7. A portion just of My own Self, having become the eternal individual Soul in the world of the living ones, draws [into service] the sense organs, of which the sixth is the mind, and which rest in the Prakrti.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.8. Whatsoever body he attains to and also from whatsoever He goes up, the Lord proceeds taking them with Him just as the wind takes odours from their receptacle.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.9. Presiding over the ear, the eye, the touch-sense the taste-sense and also the smell-sense and the mind, He enjoys the sense objects.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.10. The deluded do not perceive; [but] the men of knowledge-eye do see Him, as He dwells of rises up or enjoys what is endowed with Strands.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.11. The exerting men of Yoga perceive Him dwelling in the Self. [But] the unintelligent men with their uncontrolled self do not perceive Him, even though they exert.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.12. That light which is found in the sun, which is in the moon, and which is [also] in the fire-all illuminating the entire world-know that light to be of Mine.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.13. And penetrating the earth I support [all] beings with [My] energy; being the sapful moon, I nourish all plants.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.14. Being the digestive fire dwelling within the body of living creatures, and being in association with the upward and downward winds [of the body], I digest the four kinds of food.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.15. I am entered (the Self-conciousness is felt) in the heart of all; from Me (this Self-consciousness) come the faculty of memory, the faculty of knowing, and also the faculty of differentiating; none but Me is to be known by means of all the Vedas and I am alone the author of the final part of the Vedas and also the author of the Vedas themselves.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.16. There are two persons in the world, the perishing and the nonperishing : the perishing is all elements [and] the speak-like One is called the nonperishing.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.17. But the Highest Person, distinct [from both this] is spoken of as the Supreme Self, which, being the changeless Lord, sustains the triad of the world by entering into it.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.18. Becuase, I have transcended the perishing and also the nonperishing, therefore I am acclaimed in the world as well as in the Veda as the Highest of persons.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.19. He, who, being not deluded, thus knows Me as the Highest of persons - he knows all and serves Me with his entire being, O descendant of Bharata !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.20. Thus the most secret scripture has been taught by Me, O sinless one; by understanding this, let a man become wise and also become one who has accomplished what reires to be accomplished, O descendant of Bharata !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.1. The Bhagavat said Fearlessness, complete purity of the Sattva, steadfastness in knowledge-Yoga, charity, and self-restraint and [Vedic] sacrifice, recitation of scriptures, austerity, uprightness;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.2. Harmlessness, truth, absence of anger, renunciation, absence of attachment, absence of calumny, compassion to living beings, and absence of greed, gentleness, modesty, absence of thoughtlessness;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.3. Vital power, forgiveness, fortitude, contenment, absence of treachery and absence of excessive pride-these are in the person who is born for divine wealth, O Descendant of Bharata !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.4. Ostentation, arrogance, pride, anger, and also harshness, and ignorance, are in the person born for the demoniac wealth, O son of Prtha !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.5. The divine wealth is meant for total emancipation and the demoniac one is meant for complete bondage. Grieve not, O son of Pandu. For the divine wealth you are born

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.6. There are two types of creations of beings in this world [viz.] the divine and also the demoniac. The divine one has been properly described in detail; hear [now] the demoniac one from Me, O son of Prtha !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.7. The demoniac men do not know the origin and the withdrawal; neither purity, nor good conduct, nor truth does exist in them.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.8. They say that this world is without truth; has no basis; and has no Lord; this is born not on the basis of the mutual cause-and-effect-relation [of the things]; it has nothing [beyond] and has no cause.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.9. Clinging to this view, the inauspcious men of the ruined Souls, of the poor intellect, and of the cruel deeds, strive for the destruction of the world.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.10. Holding to their insatiable desire; being possessed by hypocricy, avarice, and pride; and holding evil intention, these cruel men wander with impure resolve.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.11. Adhering to their anxiety that is ultimited and may end only at the time of dissolution; viewing the gratification of their desires alone as their highest goal; ascertaining that this much alone exists;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.12. Being bound by hundreds of ropes of longing; and being devoted to their desire and anger, they seek, by unjust means, hoards with wealth, for the purpose of the gratification of their desires.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.13. 'This has been gained by me to-day; this object of my desire I shall attain in future; this is mine [now]; and this wealth also shall be mine [soon]';

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.14. 'That enemy has been slain by me; and I shall slay others also; I am the lord; I am a man of enjoyment; I am successful, mighty and happy';

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.15. 'I am rich; I am of of noble birth; who else is eal ot me ? I shall perform sacrifices; I shall give gifts; and I shall rejoice' - deluded by these wrong ideas;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.16. Endowed with many thoughts; confused highly; enslaved simply by their delusion; and addicated to the gratification of desires; they fall into the hell and into what is foul.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.17. Self-conceited, stubborn, filled with pride and arrogance of wealth, they pretend to perform sacrifices with hypocricy, not following injunction [of the Vedas].

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.18. Clinging fast to egotism, force, pride, craving, and anger, these envious men hate Me in the bodies of their own and of others.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.19. These hateful, cruel, basest men, I hurl incessantly into the inauspicious demoniac wombs alone in the cycle of birth-and-death.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.20. Having come to the demoniac womb, birth after birth, and not attaining Me at all, these deluded persons, therefore, pass to the lowest state, O son of Kunti !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.21. To the hell, three-fold is the gate that ruins the Self : [They are] desire, anger as well as greed. Hence one should avoid these three.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.22. O son of Kunti ! A man, who has deserted these three gates of darkness, does what is good for his Self and thery reaches the highest goal.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.23. He, who neglects the injunction of the scriptures, and acts according to his own will-he attains neither the success, nor happiness nor the highest goal (emancipation).

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 16.24. Therefore, by considering the scripture as your authority in determining as to what is to be done and what is not to be done, you should perform action, laid down by the regulations of the scriptures.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.1. Arjuna said Those who remain with faith, but neglecting the scriptural injunction, - what is their state ? Is it Sattva, Rajas or Tamas ? O Krsna !

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.2. The Bhagavat said The faith of the embodied persons is born of their nature and is of three kinds [viz৷৷] that which is made of the Sattva ; that which is made of the Rajas ; and that which is made of the Tamas. Listen about them.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.3. Corresponding to one's own sattva everybody has faith, O descendant of Bharata ! The person predominantly consists of the faith. What one has faith in, that he is (becomes) certainly.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.4. The men of the Sattva (Strand) perform sacrifice intending for the gods ; the men of the Rajas (Strand) do for the spirits and the demons; and the men of the Tamas (Strand) perform sacrifices intending for the imps, the dead, and the ghosts.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.5. Those men, who practise terrible austerities, not as enjoined in the scriptures; who are bound to hypocricy and conceit, and are endowed with (i.e. impelled by) the force of passion for the desired objects;

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.6. Who emaciate unintelligently the conglamoration of elements in their physic and emaciate Me too, dwelling within the physic-know them to be of a demoniac resolve.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.7. Further, the food also, which is dear to all, is of three kinds. So are [their] sacrifice, austerity and charity. Listen to this distinction of them.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.8. The foods that increase life, energy, strength, good health, happiness and satisfaction; and which are delicious, soft, substantial and pleasant to heart (stomach) - they are dear to the men of the Sattva (Strand).

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.9. The foods that are killed by men of the Rajas (Strand) are those which are bitter, sour, saltish, very hot, harsh, dry, and burning; and which cause pain, grief and disease.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.10. What is old, bereft of taste, ill-smelling, and stale; what is also left after eating, and is impure - such a food is dear to the men of the Tamas (Strand).

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.11. That sacrifice is of the Sattva (Strand), which is offered, as found in the injunction, by men craving for no fruit, by stabilizing their mind with the thought that it is just a thing to be offered.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.12. What is offered aiming at fruit and also only for the sake of display-know that sacrifice to be of the Rajas (Strand) and to be transitary and impermanent.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.13. That sacrifice they declare to be of the Tamas (Strand) which is devoid of scriptural injunction, in which there is no [recitation of] Vedic hymns, where no food and [sacrifical] fee are distributed, and which is totally devoid of faith.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.14. The worship to the gods, to the twice-born, to the elders and to the wise; the purity, the honesty, the state of continence, and the harmlessness-all this is said to be bodily austerity.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.15. The unoffending speech which is true, and which is pleasant and beneficial; and also the practice of regular recitation of the Vedas - all this is said to be an austerity by the speech-sense.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.16. The serenity of mind, the ietness, the taciturnity, the self-control, the purity of thought-all this is called mental austerity.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.17. This three-fold austerity, undertaken (observed) with best faith, by men who are maters of Yoga and have no desire for its fruits-they call it to be of the Sattva.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.18. The austerity that is practised for gaining respect, honour and reverence and with sheer showing-that is called here [austerity] of the Rajas and it is unstable and impermanent.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.19. What austerity is practised with foolish obstinacy [and] with self-torture only in order to destroy other person-that is declared to be of the Tamas.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 17.20. A gift which is given with the thought that 'One must give' and is given in a proper place, and at correct time to a worthy person, incapable of obliging in return-that gift is held to be of the Sattva.

author: Dr. S. S. Sankaranarayan
