author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.15 The foolish evildoers, who are the most depraved among men, who are deprived of (their) wisdom by Maya, and who resort to demoniacal ways, do not take refuge in Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.16 O Arjuna, foremost of the Bharata dynasty, four classes of people of virtuous deeds adore Me: the afflicted, the seeker of Knowledge, the seeker of wealth and the man of Knowledge.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.17 Of them, the man of Knowledge, endowed with constant steadfastness and one-pointed devotion, excels. For I am very much dear to the man of Knowledge, and he too is dear to Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.18 All of these, indeed, are noble, but the man of Knowledge is the very Self. (This is) My opinion. For, with a steadfast mind, he is set on the path leading to Me alone who am the super-excellent Goal.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.19 At the end of many births the man of Knowledge attains Me, (realizing) that Vasudeva is all. Such a high-souled one is very rare.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.20 People, deprived of their wisdom by desires for various objects and guided by their own nature, resort to other deities following the relevant methods.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.21 Whichever form (of a deity) any devotee wants to worship with faith, that very firm faith of his I strengthen.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.22 Being imbued with that faith, that person engages in worshipping that form, and he gets those very desired results therefrom as they are dispensed by Me alone.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.23 That result of theirs who are of poor intellect is indeed limited. The worshippers of gods go to the gods. My devotees go to Me alone.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.24 The unintelligent, unaware of My supreme state which is immutable and unsurpassable, think of Me as the unmanifest that has become manifest.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.25 Being enveloped by yoga-maya, I do not become manifest to all. This deluded world does not know Me who am birthless and undecaying.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.26 O Arjuna, I know the past and the present as also the future beings; but no one knows Me!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.27 O scion of the Bharata dynasty, O destroyer of foes, due to the delusion of duality arising from likes and dislikes, all creatures become bewildered at the time of their birth.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.28 On the other hand, those persons who are of virtuous deeds, whose sin has come to an end, they, being free from the delusion of dulaity and firm in their convictions, adore Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.29 Those who strive by resorting to Me for becoming free from old age and death, they know that Brahman, everything about the individual Self, and all about actions. [They know Brahman as being all the individual entities and all actions. This verse prescribes meditation on the alified Brahman for aspirants of the middle class. Verses beginning with the 14the speak about the reaization of the unalified Brahman by aspirants of the highest class.]

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 7.30 Those who know me as existing in the physical and the divine planes, and also in the context of the sacrifice, they of concentrated minds know Me even at the time of death.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Swami Gambirananda did not comment on this sloka

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.2 O Madhusudana, how, and who, is the entity existing in the sacrifice here in this body? And at the time of death, how are You to be known by people of concentrated minds?

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.3 The Blessed Lord said The Immutable is the supreme Brahman; self-hood is said to the entity present in the individual plane. By action is meant the offerings which bring about the origin of the existence of things.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.4 The which exists in the physical plane is the mutable entity, and what exists in the divine plane is the Person. O best among the embodied beings, I Myself am the entity that exists in the sacrifice in this body.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.5 And at the time of death, anyone who departs by giving up the body while thinking of Me alone, he attains My state. There is no doubt about this.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.6 O son of Kunti, thinking of any entity whichever it may be one gives up the body at the end, he attains that very one, having been always engrossed in its thought.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.7 Therefore, think of Me at all times and fight. There is no doubt that by dedicating your mind and intellect to Me, you will attain Me alone.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.8 O son of Prtha, by meditating with a mind which is engaged in the yoga of practice and which does not stray away to anything else, one reaches the supreme Person existing in the effulgent region.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.9 He who meditates on the Omniscient, the Anceint, the Ruler, subtler than the subtle, the Ordainer of everything, of inconceivable form, effulgent like the sun, and beyond darkness-(he attains the supreme Person).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.10 At the time of death, having fully fixed the Prana (vita force) between the enrows with an unswering mind, and being imbued with devotion as also the strength of concentration, he reaches that resplendent supreme person.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.11 I shall speak to you briefly of that immutable Goal which the knowers of the Vedas declare, into which enter the deligent ones free from attachment, and aspiring for which people practise celibacy.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.12 Having controlled all the passages, having confined the mind in the heart, and having fixed his own vital force in the head, (and then) continuing in the firmness in yoga;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.13 He who departs by leaving the body while uttering the single syllable, viz Om, which is Brahman, and thinking of Me, he attains the supreme Goal.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.14 O son of Prtha, to that yogi of constant concentration and single-minded attention, who remembers Me uninterruptedly and for long, I am easy of attainment.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.15 As a result of reaching Me, the exalted ones who have attained the highest perfection do not get rirth which is an abode of sorrows and which is impermanent.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.16 O Arjuna, all the worlds together with the world of Brahma are subject to return. But, O son of Kunti, there is no rirth after reaching Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.17 Those poeple who are knowers of what day and night are, know the day of Brahma which ends in a thousand yugas [The four yugas (in the human worlds), viz Satya, Treta, Dwapara, and Kali are made up of 4,320,000 years. This period multiplied by a thousand constitutes one day of Brahma. His night also extends over an eal period. See M.S. and V.S.A.], and His night which ends in a thousand yugas.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.18 With the coming of day all manifested things emerge from the Unmanifest and when night comes they merge in that itself which is called the Unmanifested.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.19 O son of Prtha, after being born again and again, that very multitude of beings disappears in spite of itself at the approach of night. It comes to life at the approach of day.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.20 But distinct from that Unmanifested is the other eternal unmainfest Reality, who does not get destroyed when all beings get destroyed.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.21 He who has been mentioned as the Unmanifested, the Immutable, they call Him the supreme Goal. That is the supreme abode of Mine, reaching which they do not return.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.22 O son of Prtha, that supreme Person-in whom are included (all) the beings and by whom all this is pervaded-is, indeed, reached through one-pointed devotion.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.23 O best of the Bharata dynasty, I shall now speak of that time by departing at which the yogis attain the State of Non-return, and also (of the time by departing at which they attain) the State of Return.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.24 Fire, light, daytime, the birght forrnight, the six months of the Northern solstice-by following this Path, persons who are knowers of Brahman attain Brahman when they die.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.25 Smoke, night, as also the dark fortnight and the six months of the Southern solstice-following this Path the yogi having reached the lunar light, returns.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.26 These two courses of the world, which are white and black, are verily considered eternal. By the one a man goes to the State of Non-return; by the other he returns again.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.27 O son of Prtha, no yogi [One steadfast in meditation.) whosoever has known these two courses becomes deluded. Therefore, O Arjuna, be you steadfast in yoga at all times.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 8.28 Having known this, the yogi transcends all those results of rigtheous deeds that are declared with regard to the Vedas, sacrifices, austerities and also charities, and he reaches the primordial supreme State.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.1 The Blessed Lord said However, to you who are not given to cavilling I shall speak of this highest secret itself, which is Knowledge [Jnana may mean Brahman that is Consciousness, or Its knowledge gathered from the Vedas (paroksa-jnana). Vijnana is direct experience (aparoksa-jnana).] combined with experience, by realizing which you shall be free from evil.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.2 This is the Sovereign Knowledge, the Sovereign Profundity, the best sanctifire; directly realizable, righteous, very easy to practise and imperishable.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.3 O destroyer of foes, persons who are regardless of this Dharma (knowledge of the Self) certainly go round and round, without reaching Me, along the path of transmigration which is fraught with death.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.4 This whole world is prevaded by Me in My unmanifest form. All beings exist in Me, but I am not contained in them!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.5 Nor do the beings dwell in Me. Behod My divine Yoga! I am the sustainer and originator of beings, but My Self is not contained in the beings.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.6 Understand thus that just as the voluminous wind moving everywhere is ever present in space, similarly all beings abide in Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.7 O son Kunti, all the beings go back at the end of a cycle to My Prakrti. I project them forth again at the beginning of a cycle.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.8 Keeping My own prakrti under control, I project forth again and again the whole of this multitude of beings which are powerless owing to the influence of (their own) nature.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.9 O Dhananjaya (Arjuna), nor do those actions bind Me, remaining (as I do) like one unconcerned with, and unattached to, those actions.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.10 Under Me as the supervisor, the Prakrti produces (the world) of the moving and the non-moving things. Owing to this reason, O son of Kunti, the world revolves.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.11 Not knowing My supreme nature as the Lord of all beings, foolish people disregard Me who have taken a human body.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.12 Of vain hopes, of vain actions, of vain knowledge, and senseless, they become verily possessed of the deceptive disposition of fiends and demons.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.13 O son of Prtha, the noble ones, being possessed of divine nature, surely adore Me with single-mindedness, knowing Me as the immutable source of all objects.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.14 Always glorifying Me and striving, the men of firm vows worship Me by paying obeisance to Me and being ever endowed with devotion.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.15 Others verily worship Me by adoring exclusively through the sacrifice of the knowledge of oneness; (others worship Me) multifariously, and (others) as the multiformed existing variously.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.16 I am the kratu, I am the yajna, I am the svadha, I am the ausadha, I am the mantra, I Myself am the ajya, I am the fire, and I am the act of offering.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.17 Of this world I am the father, mother, ordainer, (and the), grand-father; I am the knowable, the sancitifier, the syllable Om as also Rk, Sama and Yajus.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.18 (I am) the fruit of actions, the nourisher, the Lord, witness, abode, refuge, friend, origin, end, foundation, store and the imperishable seed.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.19 O Arjuna, I give heat, I withhold and pour down rain. I am verily the nectar, and also death existence and nonexistence.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.20 Those who are versed in the Vedas, who are drinkers of Soma and are purified of sin, pray for the heavenly goal by worshipping Me through sacrifices. Having reached the place (world) of the king of gods, which is the result of righteousness, they enjoy in heaven th divine pleasure of gods.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.21 After having enjoyed that vast heavenly world, they enter into the human world on the exhaustion of their merit. Thus, those who follow the rites and duties prescribed in the three Vedas, and are desirous of pleasures, attain the state of going and returning.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.22 Those persons who, becoming non-different from Me and meditative, worship Me everywhere, for them, who are ever attached (to Me), I arrange for securing what they lack and preserving what they have.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.23 Even those who, being devoted to other deities and endowed with faith, worship (them), they also, O son of Kunti, worship Me alone (though) following the wrong method.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.24 I indeed am the enjoyer as also the Lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in reality. Therefore they fall.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.25 Votaries of the gods reach the gods; the votarites of the manes go to the manes; the worshippers of the Beings reach the Beings; and those who worship Me reach Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.26 Whoever offers Me with devotion-a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water, I accept that (gift) of the pure-hearted man which has been devotionally presented.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.27 O son of Kunti, whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer as a sacrifice, whatever you give and whatever austerities you undertake, (all) that you offer to Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.28 Thus, you will become free from bondage in the form of actions which are productive of good and bad results. Havng your mind inbued with the yoga of renunciation and becoming free, you will attain Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.29 I am impartial towards all beings; to Me there is none detastable or none dear. But those who worship Me with devotion, they exist in Me, and I too exist in them.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.30 Even if a man of very bad conduct worships Me with one-pointed devotion, he is to be considered verily good; for he has resolved rightly.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.31 He soon becomes possessed of a virtuous mind; he attains everlasting peace. Do you proclain boldly, O son of Kunti, that My devotee does not get ruined.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.32 For, O son of Prtha, even those who are born of sin-women, Vaisyas, as also Sudras [S.'s construction of this portion is: women, Vaisyas as also Sudras, and even others who are born of sin (i.e., those who are born low and are of vile deeds, viz Mlecchas, Pukkasas and others). M.S. also takes papa-yonayah (born of sin) as a separate phrase, and classifies women and others only as those darred from Vedic study, etc.-Tr.]-, even they reach the highest Goal by taking shelter under Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.33 What to speak of the holy Brahmanas as also of devout kind-sages! Having come to this ephemeral and miserable world, do you worship Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 9.34 Having your mind fixed on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, and bow down to Me. By concentrating your mind and accepting Me as the supreme Goal, you shall surely attain Me who am thus the Self.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.1 The Blessed Lord said O mighty-armed one, listen over again ot My supreme utterance, which I, wishing your welfare, shall speak to you who take delight (in it).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.2 Neither the gods nor the great sages know My majesty. For, in all respects, I am the source of the gods and the great sages.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.3 He who knows Me-the birthless, the beginningless, and the great Lord of the worlds, he, the undeluded one among mortals, becomes freed from all sins.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.4 Intelligence, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, control of the external organs, control of the internal organs, happiness, sorrow, birth, death and fear as also fearlessness;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.5 Non-injury, eanimity, satisfaction, austerity, charity, fame, infamy-(these) different dispositions of beings spring from Me alone.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.6 The seven great sages as also the four Manus of anceint days, of whom are these creatures in the world, had their thoughts fixed on Me, and they were born from My mind.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.7 One who knows truly this majesty and yoga of Mine, he becomes imbued with unwavering Yoga. There is no doubt about this.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.8 I am the origin of all; everything moves on owing to Me. Realizing thus, the wise ones, filled with fervour, adore Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.9 With minds fixed on Me, with lives dedicated to Me, enlightening each other, and always speaking of Me, they derive satisfaction and rejoice.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.10 To them who are ever devoted and worship Me with love, I grant that possession of wisdom by which they reach Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.11 Out of compassion for them alone, I, residing in their hearts, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of Knowledge.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.12-10.13 Arjuna said You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme Light, the supreme Sanctifier. All the sages as also the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala and Vyasa [Although Narada and the other sages are already mentioned by the words 'all the sages', still they are named separately because of their eminence. Asita is the father of Devala.] call You the eternal divine Person, the Primal God, the Birthless, the Omnipresent; and You Yourself verily tell me (so).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.12-10.13 Arjuna said You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme Light, the supreme Sanctifier. All the sages as also the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala and Vyasa [Although Narada and the other sages are already mentioned by the words 'all the sages', still they are named separately because of their eminence. Asita is the father of Devala.] call You the eternal divine Person, the Primal God, the Birthless, the Omnipresent; and You Yourself verily tell me (so).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.14 O Kesava, I accept to be true all this which You tell me. Certainly, O Lord, neither the gods nor the demons comprehend Your glory.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Swami Gambirananda did not comment on this sloka

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.16 Be pleased to speak in full of Your own manifestations which are indeed divine, through which manifestations You exist pervading these worlds.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.17 O Yogi, [Here yoga stands for the results of yoga, viz omniscience, omnipotence, etc.; one possessed of these is a yogi. (See Comm. on 10.7)] how shall I know You by remaining ever-engaged in meditation? And through what objects, O Lord, are You to be meditated on by me?

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.18 O Janardana, narrate to me again [In addition to what has been said in the seventh and ninth chapters.] Your onw yoga and (divine) manifestations elaborately. For, while hearing (Your) nectar-like (words), there is no satiety in me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.19 The Blessed Lord said O best of the Kurus, now, according to their importance, I shall described to you My onw glories, which are indeed divine. There is no end to my manifestations.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.20 O Gudakesa, I am the Self residing in the hearts of all beings, and I am the beginning and the middle as also the end of (all) beings.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.21 Among the Adityas [viz Dhata, Mitra, aryama, Rudra, Varuna, Surya, Bhaga, Vivasvan, Pusa, Savita, Tvasta and Visnu.-Tr.] I am Visnu; among the luminaries, the radiant sun; among the (forty-nine) Maruts [The seven groups of Maruts are Avaha, Pravaha, Vivaha, Paravaha, Udvaha, Samvaha and parivaha.-Tr.] I am Marici; among the stars I am the moon.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.22 Among the Vedas I am Sama-veda; among the gods I am Indra. Among the organs I am the mind, and I am the intelligence in creatures.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.23 Among the Rudras [Aja, Ekapada, Ahirbudhnya, Pinaki, Aparajita, Tryam-baka, Mahesvara, Vrsakapi, Sambhu, Harana and Isvara. Different Puranas give different lists of eleven names.-Tr,] I am Sankara, and among the Yaksas and goblins I am Kubera [God of wealth. Yaksas are a class of demigods who attend on him and guard his wealth.]. Among the Vasus [According to the V.P. they are: Apa, dhruva, Soma, Dharma, Anila, Anala (Fire), Pratyusa and Prabhasa. The Mbh. and the Bh. given a different list.-Tr.] I am Fire, and among the mountains I am Meru.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.24 O son of Prtha, know me to be Brhaspati, the foremost among the priests of kings. Among comanders of armies I am Skanda; among large expanses of water I am the sea.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.25 Among the great sages I am Bhrgu; of words I am the single syllable (Om) [Om is the best because it is the name as well as the symbol of Brahman.]. Among rituals I am the ritual of Japa [Japa, muttering prayers-repeating passages from the Vedas, silently repeating names of deities, etc. Rituals often involve killing of animals. But Japa is free from such injury, and hence the best.] of the immovables, the Himalaya.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.26 Among all trees (I am) the Asvatha (peepul), and Narada among the divine sages. Among the dandharvas [A class of demigods regarded as the musicians of gods.] (I am) Citraratha; among the perfected ones, the sage Kapila.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.27 Among horses, know Me to be Uccaihsravas, born of nectar; Airavata among the lordly elephants; and among men, the Kind of men. [Uccaihsravas and Airavata are respectively the divine horse and elephant of Indra.]

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.28 Among weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows I am kamadhenu. I am Kandarpa, the Progenitor, and among serpents I am Vasuki.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.29 Among snakes I am Ananta, and Varuna among gods of the waters. Among the manes I am Aryama, and among the maintainers of law and order I am Yama (King of death).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.30 Among demons I am Prahlada, and I am Time among reckoners of time. And among animals I am the loin, and among birds I am Garuda.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.31 Of the purifiers I am air; among the wielders of weapons I am Rama. Among fishes, too, I am the shark; I am Ganga among rivers.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.32 O Arjuna, of creations I am the beginning and the end as also the middle, I am the knowledge of the Self among knowledge; of those who date I am vada.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.33 Of the letters I am the letter a, and of the group of compund words I am (the compound called) Dvandva. [Dvandva: A compound of two or more words which, if not compounded, would stand in the same case and be connected by the conjunction 'and'.-Tr.] I Mayself am the infinite time; I am the Dispenser with faces everywhere.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.34 And I am Death, the destroyer of all; and the prosperity of those destined to be prosperous. Of the feminine [Narinam may mean 'of the feminine alities'. According to Sridhara Swami and S., the words fame etc. signify the goddesses of the respective alities. According to M.S. these seven goddesses are the wives of the god Dharma.-Tr.] (I am) fame, beauty, speech, memory, intelligence, fortitude and forbearance.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.35 I am also the Brhat-sama of the Sama (-mantras); of the metres, Gayatri. Of the months I am Marga-sirsa, and of the seasons, spring.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.36 Of the fraudulent I am the gambling; I am the irresistible ?nd of the mighty. I am excellene, I am effort, I am the sattva ality of those possessed of sattva.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.37 Of the vrsnis [The clan to which Sri krsna belonged, known otherwise as the Yadavas.] I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, Dhananjaya (Arjuna). And of the wise, I am Vyasa; of the omniscient, the omniscient Usanas.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.38 Of the punishers I am the rod; I am the righteous policy of those who desire to coner. And of things secret, I am verily silence; I am knowledge of the men of knowledge৷৷

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.39 Moreover, O Arjuna, whatsoever is the seed of all beings, that I am. There is no thing moving or non-moving which can exist without Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.40 O destroyer of enemies, there is no limit to My divine manifestations. This description of (My) manifestations, however, has been stated by Me by way illustration.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.41 Whatever object [All living beings] is verily endowed with majesty, possessed of prosperity, or is energetic, you know for certain each of them as having a part of My power as its source.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 10.42 Or, on the other hand, what is the need of your knowing this extensively, O Arjuna? I remain sustaning this whole creation in a special way with a part (of Myself).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.1 Arjuna said This delusion of mine has departed as a result of that speech which is most secret and known as pertaining to the Self, and which was uttered by You for my benefit.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.2 O you with eyes like lotus leaves, the origin and dissolution of beings have been heard by me in detail from You. ['From You have been heard the origin and dissolution of beings in You.'] And (Your) undecaying glory, too, (has been heard).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.3 O supreme Lord, so it is, as You speak about Yourself. O supreme Person, I wish to see the divine form of Yours.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.4 O Lord, if You think that it is possible to be seen by me, then, O Lord of Yoga, You show me Your eternal Self.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.5 The Blessed Lord said O son of Prtha, behold My forms in (their) hundreds and in thousands, of different kinds, celestial, and of various colours and shapes.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.6 See the Adiyas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Asvins and the Maruts. O scion of the Bharata dynasty, behold also the many wonders not seen before.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.7 See now, O gudakesa, O Gudakesa (Arjuna), the entire Universe together with the moving and the non-moving, concentrated at the same place here in My body, as also whatever else you would like to see.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.8 But you are not able to see Me merely with this eye of yours. I grant you the supernatural eye; bhold My divine Yoga.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.9 Sanjaya said O King, having spoken thus, thereafter, Hari [Hari: destroyer of ignorance along with its conseences.] (Krsna) the great Master of Yoga, showed to the son of Prtha the supreme divine form:

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.10 Having many faces and eyes, possessing many wonderful sights, adorned with numerous celestial ornaments, holding many uplifted heavenly weapons;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.11 Wearing heavenly garlands and apparel, anointed with heavenly scents, abounding in all kinds of wonder, resplendent, infinite, and with faces everywhere.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.12 Should the effulgence of a thousand suns blaze forth simultaneously in the sky, that might be similar to the radiance of that exalted One.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.13 At that time, Pandava saw there, in the body of the God of gods, the whole diversely differentiated Universe united in the one (Cosmic form).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.14 Then, filled with wonder, with hairs standing on end, he, Dhananjaya, (Arjuna), bowing down with his head to the Lord, said with folded hands:

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.15 Arjuna said O God, I see in Your body all the gods as also hosts of (various) classes of beings; Brahma the ruler, sitting on a lotus seat, and all the heavely sages and serpents.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.16 I see You as possessed of numerous arms, bellies, mouths and eyes; as having infinite forms all around. O Lord of the Universe, O Cosmic Person, I see not Your limit nor the middle, nor again the beginning!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.17 I see You as wearing a diadem, wielding a mace, and holding a disc; a mass of brilliance glowing all around, difficult to look at from all sides, possessed of the radiance of the blazing fire and sun, and immeasurable.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.18 You are the Immutable, the supreme One to be known; You are the most perfect repository of this Universe. You are the Imperishable, the Protector of the ever-existing religion; You are the eternal Person. This is my belief.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.19 I see You as without beginning, middle and end, possessed of infinite valour, having innumerable arms, having the sun and the moon as eyes, having a mouth like a blazing fire, and heating up this Universe by Your own brilliance.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.20 Indeed, this intermediate space between heaven and earth as also all the directions are pervaded by You alone. O exalted One, the three worlds are struck with fear by seeing this strange, fearful form of Yours.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.21 Those very groups of gods enter into You; struck with fear, some extol (You) with joined palms. Groups of great sages and perfected beings praise You with elaborate hymns,saying 'May it be well!'

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.22 Those who are the Rudras, the Adityas, the Vasus and the Sadhyas [sadhyas: A particular class of celestial beings.-V.S.A.], the Visve (-devas), the two Asvins, the Maruts and the Usmapas, and hosts of Gandharvas, Yaksas, demons and Siddhas-all of those very ones gaze at You, being indeed struck with wonder.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.23 O mighty-armed One, seeing Your immense form with many mouths and eyes, having numerous arms, thighs and feet, with many bellies, and fearful with many teeth, the creatures are struck with terror, and so am I.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.24 O Visnu, verily, seeing Your form touching heaven, blazing, with many colours, open-mouthed, with fiery large eyes, I , becoming terrified in my mind, do not find steadiness and peace.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.25 Having merely seen Your mouths made terrible with (their) teeth and resembling the fire of Dissolution, I have lost the sense of direction and find no comfort. Be gracious, O Lord of gods, O Abode of the Universe.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.26 And into You (enter) all those sons of Dhrtarastra along with multitudes of the rulers of the earth; (also) Bhisma, Drona and that son of a Suta (Karna), together with even our prominent warriors.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.27 They rapidly enter into Your terrible mouths with cruel teeths! Some are seen sticking in the gaps between the teeth, with their heads crushed!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.28 As the numerous currents of the waters of rivers rush towards the sea alone so also do those heroes of the human world enter into Your blazing mouths.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.29 As moths enter with increased haste into a glowing fire for destruction, in that very way do the creatures enter into Your mouths too, with increased hurry for destruction.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.30 You lick Your lips while devouring all the creatures from every side with flaming mouths which are completely filling the entire world with heat.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.31 Tell me who You are, fierce in form. Salutation be to you, O supreme God; be gracious. I desire to fully know You who are the Prima One. For I do not understand Your actions!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.32 The Blessed Lord said I am the world-destroying Time, [Time: The supreme God with His limiting adjunct of the power of action.] grown in stature [Pravrddhah, mighty-according to S.-Tr.] and now engaged in annihilating the creatures. Even without you, all the warriors who are arrayed in the confronting armies will cease to exist!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.33 Therefore you rise up, (and) gain fame; and defeating the enemies, enjoy a prosperous kingdom. These have been killed verily by Me even earlier; be you merely an instrument, O Savyasacin (Arjuna).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.34 You destroy Drona and Bhisma, and Jayadratha and Karna as also the other heroic warriors who have been killed by Me. Do not be afraid. Fight! You shall coner the enemies in battle.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.35 Sanjaya said Hearing this utterance of Kesava, Kiriti (Arjuna), with joined palms and trembling, protrating himself, said again to Krsna with a faltering voice, bowing down overcome by fits of fear:

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.36 Arjuna said It is proper, O Hrsikesa, that the world becomes delighted and attracted by Your praise; that the Raksasas, stricken with fear, run in all directions; and that all the groups of the Siddhas bow down (toYou).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.37 And why should they not bow down to You, O exalted [i.e. not narrow-minded.] One, who are greater (than all) and who are the first Creator even of Brahma! O infinite One, supreme God, Abode of the Universe, You are the Immutable,being and non-being, (and) that which is Transcendental.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.38 You are the primal Deity, the ancient Person; You are the supreme Resort of this world. You are the knower as also the object of knowledge, and the supreme Abode. O You of infinite forms, the Universe is pervaded by You!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.39 You are Air, Death, Fire, the god of the waters, the moon, the Lord of the creatures, and the Greater-grandfather. Salutations! Salutation be to You a thousand times; salutation to You again and again! Salutation!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.40 Salutation to You in the East and behind. Salutation be to You on all sides in deed, O All! You are possessed of infinite strength and infinite heroism. You pervade everything; hence You are all!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.41 Without knowing this greatness of Yours, whatever was said by me (to You) rashly, through inadvertence or even out of intimacy, thinking (You to be) a friend, addressing (You) as 'O krsna,' 'O Yadava,' 'O friend,' etc.-.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.42 And that You have been discourteously treated out of fun-while walking, while on a bed, while on a seat, while eating, in privacy, or, O Acyuta, even in public, for that I beg pardon of You, the incomprehensible One.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.43 You are the Father of all beings moving and non-moving; to this (world) You are worthy of worship, the Teacher, and greater (than a teacher). There is none eal to You; how at all can there be anyone greater even in all the three worlds, O You or unrivalled power?

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.44 Therefore, by bowing down and prostrating the body, I seek to propitate You who are God and are adorable. O Lord, You should [The elision of a (in arhasi of priyayarhasi) is a metrical licence.] forgive (my faults) as would a father (the faults) of a son, as a friend, of a friend, and as a lover of a beloved.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.45 I am delighted by seeing something not seen heretofore, and my mind is stricken with fear. O Lord, show me that very form; O supreme God, O Abode of the Universe, be gracious!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.46 I want to see You just as before, wearing a crown, wielding a mace, and holding a disc in hand. O You with thousand arms, O You of Cosmic form, appear with that very form with four hands.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.47 The Blessed Lord said Out of grace, O Arjuna, this supreme, radiant, Cosmic, infinite, primeval form-which (form) of Mine has not been seen before by anyone other than you, has been shown to you by Me through the power of My own Yoga.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.48 Not by the study of the Vedas and sacrifices, not by gifts, not even by rituals, not by severe austerities can I, in this form, be perceived in the human world by anyone ['By anyone who has not received My grace'. other than you, O most valiant among the Kurus.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.49 May you have no fear, and may not there be bewilderment by seeing this form of Mine so terrible Becoming free from fear and gladdened in mind again, see this very earlier form of Mine.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.50 Sanjaya said Thus, having spoken to Arjuna in that manner, Vasudeva showed His own form again. And He, the exalted One, reassured this terrified one by again becoming serene in form.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.51 Arjuna said O Janardana, having seen this serene human form of Yours, I have now become calm in mind and restored to my own nature.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.52 The Blessed Lord said This form of Mine which you have seen is very difficult to see; even the gods are ever desirous of a vision of this form.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.53 Not through the Vedas, not by austerity, not by gifts, nor even by sacrifice can I be seen in this form as you have seen Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.54 But, O Arjuna, by single-minded devotion am I-in this form-able to be known and seen in reality, and also be entered into, O destroyer of foes.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 11.55 O son of Pandu, he who works for Me, accepts Me as the supreme Goal, is devoted to Me, is devoid of attachment and free from enmity towards all beings-he attains Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.1 Arjuna said Those devotees who, being thus ever dedicated, meditate on You, and those again (who meditate) on the Immutable, the Unmanifested-of them, who are the best experiencers of yoga [(Here) yoga means samadhi, spiritual absorption.] ?

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.2 The Blessed Lord said Those who meditate on Me by fixing their minds on Me with steadfast devotion (and) being endowed with supreme faith-they are considered to be the most perfect yogis according to Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Swami Gambirananda did not comment on this sloka

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.4 By fully controlling all the organs and always being even-minded, they, engaged in the welfare of all beings, attain Me alone.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.5 For them who have their minds attached to the Unmanifested the struggle is greater; for, the Goal which is the Unmanifest is attained with difficulty by the embodied ones.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.6 As for those who, having dedicated all actions to Me and accepted Me as the supreme, meditate by thinking of Me with single-minded concentration only-.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.7 O son of Prtha, for them who have their minds absorbed in Me, I become, without delay, the Deliverer from the sea of the world which is fraught with death.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.8 Fix the mind on Me alone; in Me alone rest the intellect. There is no doubt that hereafter you will dwell in Me alone. [For the sake of metre, eva and atah (in the second line of the verse) are not joined together (to form evatah).]

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.9 If, however, you are unable to establish the mind steadily on Me, then, O Dhananjaya, seek to attain Me through the Yoga of Practice.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.10 If you are unable even to practise, be intent on works for Me. By undertaking works for Me as well, you will attain perfection. [Identity with Brahman.]

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.11 If you are unable to do even this, in that case, having resorted to the Yoga for Me, thereafter renounce the results of all works by becoming controlled in mind.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.12 Knowledge is surely superior to practice; meditation surpasses knowledge. The renunciation of the results of works (excels) meditation. From renunciation, Peace follows immediately.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.13 He who is not hateful towards any creature, who is friendly and compassionate, who has no idea of 'mine' and the idea of egoism, who is the same under sorrow and happiness, who is forgiving;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.14 He who is ever content, who is a yogi, who has self-control, who has firm conviction, who has dedicated his mind and intellect to Me-he who is such a devotee of Mine is dear to Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.15 He, too, owing to whom the world is not disturbed, and who is not disturbed by the world, who is free from joy, impatience, fear and anxiety, is dear to Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.16 He who has no desires, who is pure, who is dextrous, who is impartial, who is free from fear, who has renounced every undertaking-he who is (such) a devotee of Mine is dear to Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.17 He who does not rejoice, does not fret, does not lament, does not hanker; who gives up good and bad, who is filled with devotion-he is dear to Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: Swami Gambirananda did not comment on this sloka

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.19 The person to whom denunciation and praise are the same, who is silent, content with anything, homeless, steady-minded, and full of devotion is dear to Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 12.20 But [Tu (but) is used to distinguish those who have attained the highest Goal from the aspirants.-Tr.] those devotees who accept Me as the supreme Goal, and with faith seek for this ambrosia [M.S.'s reading is dharmamrtam-nectar in the form of virtue. Virtue is called nectar because it leads to Immortality, or because it is sweet like nectar.] which is indistinguishable from the virtues as stated above, they are very dear to Me.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.2 The Blessed Lord said O son of Kunti, this body is referred to as the 'field'. Those who are versed in this call him who is conscious of it as the 'knower of the field'.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.3 And, O scion of the Bharata dynasty, under-stand Me to be the 'Knower of the field' in all the fields. In My opinion, that is Knowledge which is the knowlege of th field and the knower of the field.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.4 Hear from Me in brief about (all) that as to what that field is and how it is; what its changes are, and from what cause arises what effect; and who He is, and what His powers are.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.5 It has been sung of in various ways by the Rsis, separately by the different kinds [The different branches of Vedic texts.] of Vedic texts, and also by the rational and convicing sentences themselves which are indicatvie of and lead of Brahman.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.6 The great elements, egoism, intellect and the Unmanifest itself; the ten organs and the one, and the five objects of the senses;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.7 Desire, repulsion, happiness, sorrow, the aggregate (of body and organs), sentience, fortitude- this field, together with its modifications, has been spoken of briefly.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.8 Humility, unpretentiousness, non-injury, for-bearance, sincerity, service of the teacher, cleanliness, steadiness, control of body and organs;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.9 Non-attachment with regard to objects of the senses, and also absence of egotism; seeing the evil in birth, death, old age, diseases and miseries;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.10 Non-attachment and absence of fondness with regard to sons, wives, homes, etc., and constant eanimity of the mind with regard to the attainment of the desirable and the undesirable;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.11 And unwavering devotion to Me with single-minded concentration; inclination to repair into a clean place; lack of delight in a crowd of people;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.12 Steadfastness in the knowledge of the Self, contemplation on the Goal of the knowledge of Reality-this is spoken of as Knowledge. Ignorance is that which is other than this.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.13 I shall speak of that which is to be known, by realizing which one attains Immortality. The supreme Brahman is without any beginning. That is called neither being nor non-being.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.14 That (Knowable), which has hands and feet everwhere, which has eyes, heads and mouths everywhere, which has ears everywhere, exists in creatures by pervading them all.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.15 Shining through the functions of all the organs, (yet) devoid of all the organs; unattached, and verily the supporter of all; without ality, and the perceiver of alities;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.16 Existing outside and inside all beings; moving as well as non-moving, It is incomprehensible due to subtleness. So also, It is far away, and yet near.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.17 And the Knowable, though undivided, appears to be existing as divided in all beings, and It is the sustainer of all beings as also the devourer and originator.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.18 That is the Light even of the lights; It is spoken of as beyond darkness. It is Knowledge, the Knowable, and the Known. It exists specially [A variant reading is dhisthitam.-Tr.] in the hearts of all.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.19 Thus has been spoken of in brief the field as also Knowledge and the Knowable. By understanding this My devotee becomes alified for My state.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.20 Know both Nature and also the individual soul [Prakrti is sometimes translated as matter, and purusa as spirit.-Tr.] to be verily without beginning; know the modifications as also the alities as born of Nature.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.21 With regard to the source of body and organs, Nature is said to be the cause. The soul is the cause so far as enjoyership of happiness and sorrow is concerned.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.22 Since the soul is seated in Nature, therefore it experiences the alities born of Nature. Contact with the alities is the cause of its births in good and evil wombs.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.23 He who is the Witness, the Permitter, the Sustainer, the Experiencer, the great Lord, and who is also spoken of as the transcendental Self is the supreme Person in this body.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.24 He who knows thus the Person and Nature along with the alities will not be born again, in whatever way he may live.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.25 Through meditation some realize the Self in (their) intellect with the help of the internal organ; others through Sankhya-yoga, and others through Karma-yoga.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.26 Others, agian, who do not know thus, take to thinking after hearing from others; they, too, who are devoted to hearing, certainly overcome death.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.27 O scion of the Bharata dynasty, whatever object, moving or non-moving, comes into being, know that to be from the association of the field and the Knower of the field!

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.28 He sees who sees the supreme Lord as existing eally in all beings, and as the Imperishable among the perishable.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.29 Since by seeing eally God who is present alike everywhere he does not injure the Self by the Self, therefore he attains the supreme Goal.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.30 And he who sees actions as being done in various ways by Nature itself, and also the Self as the non-agent,-he sees.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.31 When one realizes that the state of diversity of living things is rooted in the One, and that their manifestation is also from That, then one becomes identified with Brahman.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.32 Being without beginning and without alities, O son of Kunti, this immutable, supreme Self does not act. nor is It affected [Also translated as tainted.-Tr.], although existing in the body.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.33 As the all-pervading space is not defiled, because of its subtlety, similarly the Self, present everywhere in the body [The singular number is used to denote a class, i.e. all bodies. See S.-Tr.], is not defiled.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.34 As the single sun illumines this whole world, similarly, O descendant of the Bharata dynasty, the Knower of the field illumines the whole field.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 13.35 Those who know thus through the eye of wisdom the distinction between the field and the Knower of the field, and the annihilation of the Matrix of beings,-they reach the Supreme.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.1 The Blessed Lord said I shall speak again of the supreme Knowledge, the best of all knowledges, by realizing which all the contemplatives reached the highest Perfection from here.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.2 Those who attain identity with Me by resorting of this Knowledge are not born even during creation, nor do they suffer pain during dissolution.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.3 My womb is the great-sustainer. In that I place the seed. From that, O scion of the Bharata dynasty, occurs the birth of all things.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.4 O son of Kunti, whatever forms are born from all the wombs, of them the great-sustainer is the womb; I am the father who deposits the seed.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.5 O mighty-armed one, the alities, viz sattva, rajas and tamas, born of Nature, being the immutable embodies being to the body.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.6 Among them, sattva, being pure, [Nirmala, pure-transparent, i.e., capable of resisting any form of ignorance, and hence as illuminator, i.e.a revealer of Consciousness.] is an illuminator and is harmless. O sinless one, it binds through attachment to happiness and attachment to knowledge.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.7 Know rajas to be of the nature of passion, born of hankering and attachment. O son of Kunti, that binds the embodied one through attachment to action.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.8 On the other hand, know tamas, which deludes all embodied beings, to be born of ignorance. O scion of the Bharata dynasty, that binds through inadvertence, laziness and sleep.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.9 O scion of the Bharata dynasty, sattva attaches one to happiness, rajas to action, while tamas, covering up knowledge, leads to inadvertence also.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.10 O scion of the Bharata dynasty, sattva increases by subduing rajas and tamas, rajas by overpowering sattva and tamas, and tamas by dominating over sattva and rajas.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.11 When the illumination that is knowledge radiates in this body through all the doors (of the senses), then one should know that sattva has increased greatly.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.12 O best of the Bharata dynasty, when rajas becomes predominant, these come into being: avarice, movement, undertaking of actions, unrest and hankering.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.13 O descendant of the Kuru dynasty, when tamas predominates these surely [i.e. without exception.-M.S.] come into being: non-discrimination and inactivity, inadvertence and delusion.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.14 When an embodied one undergoes death while sattva is exclusively prodominant, then he attains the taintless worlds of those who know the highest (entities).

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.15 When one dies while rajas predominates, he is born among people attached to activity. Similarly, when one dies while tamas predominates, he takes birth among the stupid species.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.16 They say that the result of good work is pure and is born of sattva. But the result of rajas is sorrow; the result of tamas is ignorance.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.17 From sattva is born knowledge [Knowledge acired through the sense-organs.], and from rajas, verily, avarice. From tamas are born inadvertence and delusion as also ignorance, to be sure.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.18 People who conform to sattva go higher up; those who conform to rajas stay in the middle; those who conform to tamas, who conform to the actions of the lowest ality, go down.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.19 When the witness sees none other than the alities as the agent, and knows that which is superior [i.e. different from.] to the alities, he attains My nature.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.20 Having transcended these three alities which are the origin of the body, the embodied one, becoming free from birth, death, old age and sorrows, experiences Immortality.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.21 Arjuna said O Lord, by what signs is one (known) who has gone beyond these three alities? What is his behaviour, and how does he transcend these three alities?

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.22 The Blessed Lord said O son of Pandu, he neither dislikes illumination (knowledge), activity and delusion when they appear, nor does he long for them when they disappear.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.23 He who, sitting like one indifferent, is not distracted by the three alities; he who, thinking that the alities alone act, remains firm and surely does not move;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.24 He to whom sorrow and happiness are alike, who is established in his own Self, to whom a lump of earth, iron and gold are the same, to whom the agreeable and the disagreeable are the same, who is wise, to whom censure and his own praise are the same;

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.25 He who is the same under honour and dishonour, who is eally disposed both towards the side of the friend and of the foe, who has renounced all enterprise,-he is said to have gone beyond the alities.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.26 And he who serves Me through the unswerving Yoga of Devotion, he, having gone beyond these alities, alifies for becoming Brahman.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 14.27 For I am the Abode of Brahman-the indestructible and immutable, the eternal, the Dharma and absolute Bliss.

author: Swami Gambirananda
alignmentStatus: first review verified (google/gemini-3.8-flash); second review pending
content: 15.1 The Blessed Lord said They say that the peepul Tree, which has its roots upward and the branches downward, and of which the Vedas are the leaves, is imperishable. He who realizes it is knower of the Vedas.
